description:
Descrição da vaga
Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único
Estamos em busca de um Analista de Folha de Pagamento Sênior para atuar nas rotinas de processamento da folha e administração de pessoal, assegurando a acurácia e a conformidade dos cálculos e pagamentos, além de contribuir para melhorias contínuas, confiabilidade das operações e cumprimento dos prazos legais.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Executar todo o processo de folha de pagamento, inputs, apuração e lançamentos necessários para o processamento da folha, garantindo a conformidade com a legislação trabalhista, previdenciária e fiscal.
Calcular, via sistema, salários, encargos sociais e impostos incidentes sobre a folha de pagamento, assegurando o cumprimento dos prazos legais de pagamento e recolhimento.
Apurar encargos trabalhistas, bem como executar o processo de contabilização, provisão e conciliação da folha de pagamento em conjunto com a área contábil.
Apoiar os processos de administração de pessoal, incluindo conferência e importação do ponto para a folha, cálculo e pagamento de férias e rescisões, assegurando conformidade legal e cumprimento de prazos.
Apoiar a implantação e estabilização de novos sistemas de folha de pagamento, atuando no mapeamento de processos, testes, validação de dados, homologação de cálculos e suporte à transição, garantindo a continuidade e a acuracidade das rotinas de folha.
Acompanhar e dar suporte a colaboradores em processos de transferência internacional, assegurando o correto tratamento da folha, encargos e compliance local e internacional.
Requisitos e qualificações
Formação superior completa em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
Conhecimento sólido de sistemas de folha de pagamento e ponto eletrônico, com habilidade para realizar cálculos complexos e validar integrações entre sistemas.
Domínio da legislação trabalhista e previdenciária, com capacidade para interpretar convenções coletivas e aplicar regras em cenários diversos.
Familiaridade com obrigações acessórias e ferramentas de controle fiscal, como eSocial.
Experiência prévia em sistemas integrados de RH e implementação de sistemas é um diferencial.
Informações adicionais
Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?
Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)
Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas
Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado
Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.
Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final
Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:
Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO
Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.
Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.
Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo
Venha fazer parte da PRIO
Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único
Com foco no investimento e na recuperação de ativos em produção, somos especializados na gestão eficiente de reservatórios e no redesenvolvimento de campos maduros. Acreditamos na condução dos negócios, com foco em segurança e cuidado com a saúde dos seus colaboradores.
Nosso ambiente de trabalho
Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e com muitas oportunidades de participação em diferentes projetos, favorecendo o desenvolvimento profissional e o crescimento do time. Trabalhamos em um escritório open space, o que permite a integração entre todas as equipes e a Diretoria, onde todos podem participar da tomada de decisões.
Nossa cultura busca o alto desempenho e a participação efetiva de todas as pessoas. Se você sonha em se desenvolver junto com uma empresa em constante crescimento, venha fazer parte do nosso time

title: M&A Project Manager
description:
Company Description

Believe is a global artist development company. We empower local artists, labels and  publishers to grow their audiences at each stage of their careers with expertise, respect,  fairness and transparency.

Operating in 50+ countries, with more than 2,000 employees, Believe oCers a full range  of services including audience development, publishing, marketing and distribution,  with a tailor-made approach to fit any artist, label or publisher.

Believe champions independence and innovation through a unique model that  combines local expertise with a global tech platform, delivering exclusive solutions for  artists to promote and monetize their music thanks to strategic partnerships with  leading global digital service providers.

With a leading portfolio of brands that includes Nuclear Blast, naïve, TuneCore, Groove Attack, Sentric, AllPoints and Byond, Believe artists generated more than 800 billion  streams worldwide in 2024 across all genres, and were recognized with more than 70 leading industry awards.

Believe is a simplified joint-stock company under French law. 

Ready to set the tone with Believe ?

Job Description

The LATAM Project Manager will be responsible for managing all catalogue acquisition processes within the region and ensuring efficient execution of transactions from pricing to deal closing & integration. The Project Manager
will directly report to General Manager Operations with dotted line to VP Catalog Acquisition

KEY RESPONISBILITIES

  • Manage end-to-end catalogue acquisition processes across LATAM
    countries
  • Oversee and prioritize the deal pipeline in collaboration with local teams -
    assessing deal eligibility and attractivity
  • Analyze past catalogue performance, model future cash flows an
    determine target acquisition price
  • Negotiate key business and financial terms of the transactions in
    collaboration with the Catalogue Acquisition Lawyer and the local team (non-binding agreements, asset purchase agreements)
  • Prepare post-merger integration kick-off meetings, anticipating potential
    challenges and engaging relevant expert teams early in the process

Qualifications

  • Master's degree in business or finance
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in Corporate Finance, M&A or Transaction
  • Services, with a proven track record of executing M&A transactions (experience
    in IP acquisition is a plus)
  • Strong analytical profile with deep understanding of valuation techniques
    and financial modeling
  • Excellent negotiation and communication skills, with the ability to influence
    and collaborate effectively across multiple teams and geographies
  • Fluent in English, both spoken and written

Additional Information

SET THE TONE WITH US​

Working at Believe means having individual and collective impact in a fast-growing company  ​

At all stages of their careers, Believers are an important part of what we are doing: shaping the future of the music industry. ​

We need teams that truly reflect the diversity of our clients: our international presence is an inspiring and enriching work environment for each one of us, with daily opportunities to connect with our colleagues all over the world. ​

​We have two hearts at Believe - our People and our Artists. ​

We believe in THE POWER OF OUR PEOPLE, who grow every day to develop their potential… We aim to provide our Believers with the best environment to thrive. ​

​ROCK THE JOB ​

  • Tailor-made training and coaching program ​

  • Remote working policy​

  • A well-being program​

  • Access to Eutelmed, a digital mental health and well-being platform that allows you to speak with an experienced psychologist​

  • Contractor role

SING IN HARMONY​

  • Ambassador program: an employee volunteering initiative dedicated to all Believers interested in having a positive impact on Diversity, Equity & Inclusion (DEI), wellbeing and the planet.​

  • Shaping Together: A Group-wide event focused on volunteerism and community impact ​

We are committed to having a workforce that is representative of the community it serves at all levels of the organisation. We, therefore, welcome applications from all backgrounds and all sections of the community regardless of age, disability, gender, race, religion and sexual orientation.

description:
Job Description
Job Title: Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician
Location: Remote position in Brazil with in-person client visits as required
Reports to: Account Manager and CTO
Contract Type: CLT
About LG Sonic: LG Sonic is a global leader in sustainable water quality management, dedicated to developing cutting-edge technologies that help protect water ecosystems. With operations in over 50 countries, we specialize in advanced solutions for algae control, water quality monitoring, and environmental protection. Our award-winning ultrasonic technology, combined with real-time data monitoring, empowers industries, municipalities, and governments to maintain clean and healthy water bodies while reducing chemical use. At LG Sonic, we foster a dynamic and innovative work environment, driven by a passion for sustainability and technological excellence. Join our team and be part of a mission to create cleaner water for future generations.
Position Summary:
The Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician will be responsible for assembling, installing, and maintaining LG Sonic equipment at our clients' sites across various locations in Brazil. In addition to on-site technical duties, the professional will work remotely in an after-sales capacity, providing direct support and maintaining close communication with clients to ensure their needs are met effectively.
Position duties and responsibilities:
Assemble and install LG Sonic equipment at client locations throughout Brazil, ensuring proper setup and functionality.
Perform routine maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs on installed equipment to guarantee optimal performance.
Travel to client sites as needed to address technical issues and provide on-site support.
Provide remote after-sales support, responding to client inquiries, offering technical guidance, and resolving issues via phone, email, or other communication platforms.
Maintain direct and proactive communication with clients to ensure satisfaction and address their needs effectively.
Document all assembly, maintenance, and support activities, preparing detailed reports for internal records and client follow-ups.
Collaborate with the LG Sonic team to identify opportunities for equipment improvements or upgrades based on client feedback and field observations.
Adhere to safety protocols and company standards during all on-site and remote activities.
Qualification and requirements:
Must reside in Brazil and be willing to travel frequently to client sites across the country with flexibility to adapt to varying schedules.
Excellent communication skills in Portuguese and English (written and spoken) for client interactions, technical support, and reporting.
Proven experience in equipment assembly, installation, and maintenance, preferably in a technical or industrial setting.
Strong problem-solving skills
Ability to work independently in the field and remotely, with strong organizational and time-management skills.
Familiarity with remote support tools and basic computer skills for documentation and communication.
Valid driver's license and ability to operate safely in diverse working environments.
Previous experience in after-sales or customer support roles is a plus.
Why Join LG Sonic? At LG Sonic, we offer an exciting and collaborative work environment where your contributions directly impact our mission of environmental sustainability and innovation. By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to grow professionally while being a part of a global leader in water treatment technology. We believe in investing in our people and fostering an inclusive culture where every team member's ideas are valued.
LG Sonic Values: Unity, Trust, Positivism, Over deliver and Passion.
Application Process: If you are interested in joining LG Sonic, we encourage you to apply by following these steps:
Submit Your CV: Please send your updated CV in English to with the subject line: Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician.
Apply via Recruitment Platforms: You may also apply through recruitment websites where this position is posted. Please ensure your CV is submitted in English.
Application Review: Our HR team will carefully review all applications and contact shortlisted candidates for the next steps.
Interview Process: Selected candidates will be invited for interviews to assess their skills, experience, and suitability for the role.

title: Analista de Preços – Rio de Janeiro/RJ
description:
Site Name: Brazil - Rio de Janeiro
Posted Date: Mar 4 2026
Na GSK, somos movidos por ambições audaciosas para transformar vidas e gerar um impacto positivo na saúde de bilhões de pessoas em todo o mundo. Nossas Global Functions estão no centro dessa missão, atuando como pilares estratégicos que conectam todas as áreas da empresa e garantem que nossas operações sejam conduzidas com excelência, eficiência e responsabilidade.
Ao unir inovação, colaboração e uma visão global, nossas funções globais tornam possível o desenvolvimento de nossas vacinas, medicamentos e inovações científicas, apoiando cada etapa do processo até que as soluções cheguem aos pacientes. Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de contribuir diretamente para um futuro mais saudável e sustentável, trabalhando em um ambiente onde propósito e impacto caminham juntos.
Como Analista de Preços, você será responsável por garantir a precisão e integridade dos preços em sistemas e listas internas/externas, executar atualizações, controlar versões, registrar justificativas e suportar faturamento, compliance regulatório e análises comerciais.
Suas responsabilidades:
Esse cargo dá a VOCÊ a oportunidade de liderar atividades chaves para progredir na SUA carreira, algumas delas são:
Atualizar e manter listas de preços em canais e sistemas, controlando versões e justificativas.
Calcular e submeter reajustes e relatórios de comercialização conforme determinações da CMED (Câmara de Regulação do Mercado de Medicamentos) e processos internos, após aprovação do gerente de preços.
Parametrizar e validar preços em sistema para garantir conformidade fiscal e aplicação correta das políticas de preço.
Identificar, analisar e resolver divergências de preço, liberar ordens bloqueadas e apoiar correções de faturamento (net vs. gross).
Suportar processos de licitação: manter simulador de preços, validar ordens e coordenar com vendas e logística para aplicação contratual.
Apoiar auditorias internas/externas e controles SOX relacionados à base de preços e processos de precificação.
Por que VOCÊ?
Suas qualificações:
Estamos à procura de profissionais com essas características para alcançar nossos objetivos:
Ensino superior completo em Administração, Economia, Farmácia ou áreas correlatas.
Experiência em atividades de análise e reconciliação de dados para suporte a processos comerciais e operacionais (faturamento, vendas, logística ou pricing).
Experiência com sistemas ERP (preferencialmente SAP) e capacidade para parametrização/validação de preços.
Pacote Office (excel; powerPoint, Word e Outlook)
Inglês intermediário
Why GSK?
Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we're committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.
If you require any adjustments or accommodation during the selection process to better showcase your abilities, please let our team know as soon as we contact you. We're here to support you.
When applying, you may also choose to provide personal information, which helps us ensure a more inclusive selection process. Rest assured, your information will be treated with the utmost confidentiality and will not be accessible to hiring managers. Let's keep maintaining an inclusive and welcoming workplace.

title: Buyer
description:
Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact.  Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore's True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.
About Us:
SBM Offshore is the world's deepwater ocean-infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise to enable that into the future while at the same time using our expertise to support new and existing markets in the blue economy. It starts with Advancing our Core: continuing to advance the decarbonization of traditional energy production. While Pioneering More: helping to enable the energy transition and using our unique capabilities in ocean infrastructure to support more industries to grow sustainably.  Sharing our experience for a better blue tomorrow.

Purpose


  • As Buyer, you are responsible for procuring materials, equipment, and services required for project or operations execution. This role involves negotiating contracts and commercial terms, and ensuring timely delivery to support project and operations timelines and budgets.

    • Responsibilities


  • · Procurement Planning: You develop and implement procurement plans based on project requirements, timelines, and budgets.
  • · Supplier Sourcing: You follow strategic sourcing category manager framing and evaluate suppliers, ensuring they meet quality, cost, and delivery requirements.
  • · Contract Negotiation: You negotiate terms and conditions with suppliers to secure favorable agreements while mitigating risks. You align with the Category Management team as needed.
  • · Purchase Orders: You issue and manage purchase orders, ensuring accuracy and compliance with project specifications and company policies.
  • · Cost Control: You ensure procurement activities align with budget constraints and identify cost-saving opportunities without compromising quality.
  • · Compliance: You ensure all procurement activities comply with industry regulations, company policies, and safety standards.
  • · Reporting: You provide regular updates to project managers and stakeholders on procurement status, potential risks, and mitigation strategies

    • Education


  • Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, engineering, business administration, or a related field

    • Experience


  • Experience in procurement within the oil and gas industry.
  • Strong negotiation and communication skills.
  • Proficiency in procurement software and Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Excellent organizational and analytical abilities.
  • Knowledge of industry regulations and compliance requirements.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

    • Functional Competencies


    Commercial Analytics and reporting Regulatory Management Project Procurement Strategy and Management SBM Product Knowledge Purchasing Tools and Processes Strategic Sourcing and Vendor Management Contract Management Negotiation Product Costing

    GENERAL INFORMATION

    SBM Offshore N.V. is a listed holding company that is headquartered in Amsterdam. It holds direct and indirect interests in other companies that collectively with SBM Offshore N.V. form the SBM Offshore Group ("the Company"). For further information, please visit our website at The companies in which SBM Offshore N.V., directly and indirectly, owns investments are separate entities.

    SBM Offshore is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. SBM Offshore does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.  All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

description:

Promover e garantir a adoção de boas práticas de código, incluindo versionamento (Git), testes automatizados, documentação e padrões de desenvolvimento.

Experiência comprovada em Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

Domínio de práticas de DevOps e Data-Ops.
Sólidos conhecimentos em segurança de dados e gestão de acessos.

description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

#VemSerLiveOne

O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ

  • Experiência com vendas e negociação;
  • Atuação ativa em prospecção e vendas em condomínios (MDU);
  • Transformar oportunidades e desafios em conquistas;
  • Criatividade e entusiasmo nas abordagens comerciais;
  • Forte orientação para resultados e metas;
  • Excelente comunicação e foco no atendimento ao cliente;
  • Capacidade de seguir diretrizes e procedimentos da empresa;
  • Construção de relacionamento com moradores, síndicos e administradoras;
  • Participação ativa em reuniões e treinamentos da organização;
  • Utilização adequada de equipamentos de segurança quando necessário;
  • Executar atividades correlatas ao cargo conforme direcionamento da liderança;
  • Realizar vendas de todos os serviços disponibilizados pela empresa em ações externas.

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Experiência com vendas externas (diferencial em Porta a Porta ou vendas em condomínios – MDU);
  • Boa comunicação e perfil comercial;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas digitais e redes sociais;
  • Residência próxima ao local de trabalho;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em horário comercial;
  • Flexibilidade para realizar ações externas em condomínios.

INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

No Grupo Live One você vai encontrar:

  • Cultura de trabalho que respeita e valoriza as pessoas;
  • Oportunidades de desenvolvimento de carreira;
  • Plano de Cargos e Salários com crescimento horizontal e vertical;
  • Convênio Saúde pela Unimed;
  • Plano Odontológico pela Uniodonto;
  • Convênio Farmácia e Wellhub/Gympass;
  • Descontos em Instituições de Ensino Superior de até 50%;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Vale Refeição;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Day Off no aniversário.

  1. Cadastro
  2. Triagem
  3. Testes ou Avaliações
  4. Painel de Entrevistas
  5. Treinamento (etapa eliminatória)
  6. Contratação

NOSSO JEITO DE SER

Desde 2014, o Grupo Live One se destaca como uma empresa que valoriza o respeito pelas pessoas, parceria e inovação. Fundado em Campinas (SP) como parte de um grupo empresarial consolidado, crescemos rapidamente e hoje contamos com mais de 1000 colaboradores em mais de 10 estados do Brasil.

Nos últimos dois anos recebemos o selo internacional Great Place to Work (GPTW), reconhecimento que reforça nosso compromisso com um ambiente de trabalho acolhedor, colaborativo e focado em resultados.

Nossos valores são a base de tudo que fazemos:

  • Parceria que fortalece relações
  • Inovação que impulsiona o futuro
  • Respeito por cada indivíduo
  • Pessoas no centro de nossas ações
  • Atitude para enfrentar desafios
  • Comprometimento com a excelência
  • Ética em cada decisão

Queremos pessoas que se identifiquem com os nossos valores:

Sobre a Endorfina Wellness Group

A Endorfina Wellness Group é uma holding brasileira focada na construção de um ecossistema integrado de wellness, performance e comunidade.

Hoje o grupo reúne diferentes frentes sob a marca CREW, incluindo:


• Plataforma digital de treinos e bem-estar (modelo de assinatura)
• E-commerce de produtos e lifestyle
• Eventos e experiências presenciais
• Parcerias estratégicas e novas verticais em desenvolvimento

Com faturamento consolidado próximo a R$ 20 milhões anuais, estamos vivendo um novo ciclo de maturidade organizacional.

A plataforma digital é o núcleo do ecossistema e nosso principal diferencial competitivo.
Ela não é apenas um canal — é o centro da experiência, retenção e expansão do grupo.

Estamos buscando alguém para transformar essa plataforma no maior ativo estratégico da companhia.

A Missão da Posição

Transformar o produto digital e a experiência do cliente em vantagem competitiva estrutural.

Isso significa:


• Elevar retenção e reduzir churn de forma consistente
• Criar uma jornada integrada entre App, E-commerce e Eventos
• Aplicar IA como camada estratégica de eficiência e personalização
• Construir uma experiência memorável, fluida e orientada por dados
• Estruturar a área de Produto como pilar executivo da holding

Você não será apenas responsável por funcionalidades.
Será responsável por transformar experiência em crescimento sustentável.

Seu papel será:


• Definir visão e posicionamento do produto dentro do ecossistema
• Construir roadmap estratégico de curto, médio e longo prazo
• Garantir integração real entre as frentes do grupo
• Estruturar métricas claras de retenção, LTV, engajamento e satisfação
• Implementar mentalidade IA First como princípio operacional

Você será o arquiteto da experiência do cliente.

Escopo Estratégico

• Estruturação de roadmap alinhado à estratégia do grupo
• Priorização baseada em impacto e dados
• Gestão de backlog com visão executiva
• Integração com marketing, growth e operações

Jornada do Cliente & Retenção


• Mapeamento completo da jornada omnichannel
• Identificação de fricções e gargalos
• Estratégias estruturadas de retenção e engajamento
• Monitoramento e redução de churn

IA First aplicada à Experiência


• Implementação de automações inteligentes no atendimento
• Personalização baseada em comportamento e dados
• Uso de IA para ganho de eficiência operacional
• Estruturação de processos orientados por tecnologia

Experiência Omnichannel


• Integração entre App, E-commerce e Eventos
• Coerência de marca e experiência
• Criação de narrativa unificada de comunidade

Liderança & Estruturação da Área


• Montagem do time de Produto
• Estruturação de rituais, métricas e governança
• Cultura orientada a dados e experiência
• Desenvolvimento de talentos internos

Requirements

• Experiência sólida com produto digital e e-commerce
• Forte domínio de UX e jornada do cliente
• Experiência estruturada com retenção e churn

Perfil Comportamental

• Ambicioso e alinhado ao propósito da CREW

Nossa Cultura

Na Endorfina valorizamos:

• Constância

title: Expression of Interest: Placement Matching Specialist
description:
About Virtual InternshipsWe're on a mission to create a world where internships are guaranteed for all. We ensure learners have access to remote internship opportunities at innovative companies worldwide, regardless of their background, major, location, or career field choice. Our clients include universities, governments, foundations, and online education institutions.
$14.3million Series A fundraise announced in September 2022, with investors including Hambro Perks, Sequoia India & Surge, Arsenal Growth, Kaplan, and Ascend Vietnam Ventures
Ranked 20th out of 13,000 organizations to "Escape To in 2023"Featured as a Top 100 EdTech Startup by HolonIQ in 2021, 2022, and 2023
Rated as a Top 50 Rising Startup by Tech in Asia in 2022
Remote-first with 100+ employees across 20+ countries globally
B2B EdTech product, trusted by 100+ universities, 10,000+ interns, and 14,000+ companies
One of the core values at VI is transparency. Therefore feel free to "try before you apply" by visiting our VI-P Guide, which includes our values, how we operate, how we build our packages, and a few other snippets of who we are
Your RoleAt Virtual Internships, Placement Matching Specialists (PMS) are at the heart of what we do: connecting students from around the world with real, career-building remote internships.
This Expression of Interest is ideally for early-career people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and be stretched in the right way. The PMS role is a proven launchpad at VI: a high-learning, high-support environment where many people build their core skills before growing into other teams across the company within ~1-1.5 years.
If you're motivated by challenge, impact, and growth - this role is designed for you.
What You'll Be DoingAs a Placement Matching Specialist, you'll join our fast-moving Placements Team and take ownership of matching interns with global host companies across industries and time zones.
You'll work hands-on with real placements, real stakeholders, and real outcomes — learning how to communicate clearly, influence decisions, and manage complexity at pace. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:
Matching interns with suitable host companies and securing placement opportunities
Leading conversations with companies to present candidates and guide decisions
Following up consistently to keep placements moving and overcome delays
Managing multiple placements at once while staying organised and focused
Keeping systems and admin up to date so every placement runs smoothly
You'll never be left to figure things out alone — but you will be trusted to own your work and grow quickly.
Why This Role Is a LaunchpadThe PM role is one of the fastest learning roles at Virtual Internships. In a short time, you'll develop:
Confidence in professional communication and persuasion
Strong judgement through real, hands-on decision-making
The ability to manage multiple priorities without feeling overwhelmed
Ownership, resilience, and comfort working in a global, fast-paced startup environment
Many of our team members started their VI journey as PMS and have since grown into other roles across the organisation, including:
Greta, now our Head of Pre-Internship
Raksha, now our Placement Enablement Manager
Helen, now our Placement Readiness Specialist
Chi, now our Talent Acquisition Lead
The common thread? The skills they built as PMS shaped everything that came next.
Who We're Looking For
Your Attributes
You take responsibility and follow things through
You're curious, coachable, and eager to improve
You stay calm when things move fast and priorities shift
You communicate clearly and confidently in English
You're excited by learning, growth, and meaningful work
Your Experience
1–3 years of experience in sales, recruitment, customer-facing, or similar fast-paced roles
Experience working remotely or with global teams is a plus
Fresh graduates or career switchers with strong written communication and drive are welcome
Interested?If you're looking for a role that challenges you, supports your growth, and helps you build a strong career foundation — we'd love to hear from you.
While we may not have an immediate opening, we commit to reviewing your application and responding within 1-3 weeks.
Virtual Internships Perks and Benefits
Remote-First: All roles at VI are currently and will remain remote - flexibility to work from anywhere.
Flexible Working Hours: Start earlier, leave earlier, take a shorter lunch, or leave later, it's totally up to you.
Annual Leave: Wherever you are in the world, you'll get 25 days of paid annual leave per year, plus bank holidays and 5 sick days.
Life Event Leave: There are moments in life where your life responsibility is a higher priority than work (e.g. moving house, your best friend getting married, your sister having a baby) therefore, you'll get 5 days of paid life-event leave to support these occasions. You also get a day off on your birthday. This is in addition to your Annual Leave.

title: Security Specialist
description:
Who Are We?
Decentralized Masters is at the forefront of DeFi education globally. In just two years, we have grown from a pioneering pair of co-founders to over 140 dedicated professionals. Today, we are recognized as one of the fastest-growing enterprises in the sector, with industry insiders predicting our evolution into a unicorn company by 2030. Operating on a bootstrapped model, we are on track to achieve an impressive $50 million in revenue this year alone.
Our Impact
While our growth has been remarkable, we take even greater pride in the success of our clients. To date, we have empowered over 4000 investors to break into the DeFi world. At Decentralized Masters, we don't just offer education; we cultivate a powerhouse of knowledge combined with an engaging community, innovative technology, and a team of leading DeFi and blockchain experts. Our commitment is to deliver unparalleled resources designed for long-term success in the world of DeFi and Web3, ensuring our members not only safeguard but also enhance their financial future.
Our Vision
Our goal is to create the largest and most influential DeFi ecosystem the world has ever seen, starting with becoming the gold standard in DeFi education. This vision is ambitious, transformative, and poised to change the landscape of digital finance.
Are You Ready?
This is more than just a job; it's an opportunity to shape the future of Web3 technology and education. Are you ready to be part of our vision to redefine what's possible in DeFi and beyond? Apply below, and let's explore this journey together.
Check us out here:
What will you be doing?
We're looking for a hungry, junior security professional whose default instinct is to attack first, patch second. This isn't a governance-and-policy desk job. You'll spend your days trying to break into our own systems, finding the cracks before anyone else does, and then relentlessly closing them.
If your idea of a good day is discovering a misconfigured S3 bucket, popping a shell on a test environment, and writing up the fix before lunch read on.
Break things (on purpose):
Continuously run penetration tests against our web apps, APIs, internal tools, and cloud infrastructure
Conduct phishing simulations and social engineering tests against our own team
Perform recon, enumeration, and exploitation attempts on our systems in a controlled, authorized way
Hunt for vulnerabilities before real attackers do - then document and escalate them
Harden everything you find:
Work directly with engineering to remediate vulnerabilities you uncover
Tighten cloud security configurations (AWS) - IAM policies, exposed services, secrets management
Review access controls and flag over-privileged accounts, then drive least-privilege fixes
Implement and tune monitoring tools (SIEM, IDS/IPS) so we catch anything that slips through
Keep the lights on:
Assist with incident detection and response when real events occur
Help maintain audit logs and ensure we have visibility across our systems
Support compliance work (GDPR, SOC 2) as it relates to technical controls
Requirements
What You Will Bring
Must-have:
1–2 years of experience in security, pentesting, bug bounty, or a related hands-on role (or equivalent self-taught experience with proof)
Demonstrable ability to find and exploit common vulnerabilities - OWASP Top 10, misconfigurations, broken access controls
Basic cloud security knowledge (AWS preferred) - you know what "public S3 bucket" means and why it's bad
Comfortable using tools like Burp Suite, Nmap, Metasploit, or similar
Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK and how to think like a threat actor
You document your findings clearly - written reports matter as much as the exploit
Nice-to-have:
CTF experience or an active HackTheBox / TryHackMe profile
Any security certifications: eJPT, CEH, Security+, OSCP (in progress counts)
Scripting ability in Python or Bash to automate recon or testing
Interest or background in DeFi, crypto, or Web3 security
Familiarity with smart contract attack vectors (a big bonus)
Benefits
What We Offer
Competitive salary
Fully remote - work from anywhere
Unlimited PTO and flexible schedule
Team off-sites and events
A genuine mandate to break our stuff and make us stronger for it
Ready to hack with purpose?
If you've been sharpening your skills on bug bounties, CTFs, or homelab environments and want your first real shot at doing this professionally — we want to hear from you. Show us what you've found, what you've broken, and how you fixed it.

title: Retention Marketing Specialist
description:
To ensure a fair and efficient hiring process, candidates should not contact UN/COMMON employees directly regarding this role. Applications and communication must occur through the official application process.
UN/COMMON is a digital experience and marketing agency that launches and grows the world's best emerging brands. We believe the future of consumer-facing brands starts with creating authentic stories built for the consumer first and brand second. We are extremely proud to work with revolutionary brands such as Selena Gomez's Rare Beauty, Dermalogica, Liquid Death, Lemon Perfect, and more.

We are an employee and customer-centric agency bringing mission first brand stories to life to benefit the greater good and better people's lives. And we have a TON of fun doing it

The Retention Marketing Specialist owns the day-to-day execution of email and SMS production for our clients. This includes project management, content planning, copy and creative briefs, HTML builds, QA, and scheduling. You will manage end-to-end production and keep timelines on track across design, strategy, and client teams. You will work closely with a Retention Marketing Strategist to support retention strategy, reporting, and ongoing optimization. If you enjoy organized workflows, sharp deadlines, clean builds, and improving the customer journey through thoughtful messaging, you will do well here.

What You Will Do

You will manage the full production process for email campaigns and automated flows, build emails in Klaviyo or similar ESPs, write on-brand copy, create clear briefs for the design team, QA content and logic, and schedule deployments. You will maintain the monthly content calendar, drive timelines with clients, and ensure all assets and approvals stay on track. You will support the Retention Marketing Strategist by pulling performance data, analyzing results, and developing recommendations. You will build automated workflows, segmentation, and list logic, maintain list hygiene, and work confidently with Shopify apps such as Yotpo, Loyalty Lion, JustUno, and Privy.

Based on our projected customer base growth, we foresee the need for a  Retention Marketing Specialist  within the next 2-4 months to ensure we can effectively manage and nurture our expanding user community.

Requirements

What You Need

  • 2 years of experience in retention marketing, specifically across email, SMS, CRM, or loyalty programs.
  • Hands-on experience with an Email Service Platform (ESP), with a strong preference for Klaviyo.
  • Strong copywriting skills for direct-to-consumer (DTC) e-commerce, with the ability to adapt tone and style to match different client brands.
  • A solid understanding of email analytics and the ability to translate data insights into actionable strategy.
  • Clear understanding of the difference between marketing campaigns and automated flows, and knowing when to deploy each.
  • Proficiency in building segmented customer lists using behavioral and transactional data.
  • Experience working within Shopify or directly supporting Shopify-based clients.
  • A proactive, organized approach, with the ability to think through the entire customer journey and work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative team.

What Success Looks Like

Your production process is smooth, predictable, and organized. Clients trust your communication and follow your timelines. Email and SMS performance improves because of your quality and attention to detail. Strategy and reporting move faster because you stay ahead of data and execution. You keep projects aligned, informed, and on schedule. You take ownership, ask smart questions, and keep work moving forward.

Benefits

This is a contract position
Up to 40 hours weekly
Remote

The selection process includes a video interview screening, followed by role-specific discussions (possible assessment) and a final leadership conversation.

Commitment to Inclusion

UN/COMMON is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all employees can thrive and bring their full selves to work.

About UN/COMMON

UN/COMMON has been recognized by Inc. Magazine as one of the fastest-growing private companies in America, reflecting our people-driven approach to growth, innovation, and excellence.

Agency Policy

Recruiting agencies are not authorized to submit candidates for this role. UN/COMMON does not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate submissions from agencies.

title: Analista de RevOps
description:

No TecsaGroup, valorizamos a colaboração, a inovação e a tomada de decisão baseada em dados. Nosso ambiente é dinâmico, orientado a resultados e focado no desenvolvimento contínuo das pessoas.
Nesta posição, você atuará em parceria direta com o Gerente de RevOps e com as áreas de Marketing, Vendas, Produto e Operações, contribuindo para a construção e evolução da governança de dados e performance da empresa.

Acompanhar e analisar o funil completo do negócio (aquisição, ativação, conversão, receita e recompra);

Estruturar, manter e evoluir dashboards e relatórios gerenciais;
Apoiar análises de pricing, campanhas promocionais e impactos comerciais;
Organizar definições de métricas, fontes de dados e rotinas de acompanhamento;
Traduzir dados e análises complexas em informações claras e acionáveis para a liderança;
Atuar de forma integrada com os times internos, apoiando a governança de dados;
Dar suporte à tomada de decisão orientada por indicadores.
Experiências esperadas:
Vivência em áreas como RevOps, Analytics, Performance, Planejamento, FP&A ou Operações;
Experiência com análise de dados e indicadores de negócio;
Atuação prévia em ambientes digitais, startups, SaaS ou e-commerce;
Experiência na construção e acompanhamento de métricas e funis de vendas.
Requisitos e qualificações
Formação superior completa em áreas como Administração, Engenharia, Economia, Sistemas, Estatística ou correlatas (desejável);
Excel e/ou Google Sheets em nível intermediário a avançado;
Experiência sólida com análise de dados e indicadores;
Conhecimento em ferramentas de BI (Metabase, Power BI, Looker ou Tableau);
Conhecimento avançado em SQL (diferencial);
Capacidade de estruturar indicadores e integrar dados de múltiplas fontes;
Habilidade para criação de apresentações executivas;
Boa comunicação oral e escrita;

Working from Retic office in Rio de Janeiro/RJ

We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

title: Manager, Non-Competition Sites
description:
Department: Safety & Security
Location: Brazil
Description
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.
Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
THE POSITION
The Manager, Non-Competition Sites (Safety & Security) is responsible for planning, coordinating and overseeing safety and security operations across all official non-competition sites for the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027. This includes hotels, team base camps, training sites, transport hubs, the International Broadcast Centre (IBC) and other designated locations.
The role ensures that robust physical and staffed security measures are designed and implemented in line with identified risks and FIFA standards. The position leads integrated security planning for team and referee operations outside stadium environments and oversees secure movements between official sites. The Manager provides direct leadership to the Team Security Manager, TSLOs/RSLOs and relevant Venue Safety & Security Managers assigned to non-competition locations, ensuring consistency, compliance and operational excellence across all sites.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Lead the integrated safety and security planning for all official non-competition sites, including hotels, team base camps, training facilities, transport hubs, the IBC and other designated locations
Develop scalable security concepts tailored to diverse site types and operational risk profiles, including transport security considerations
Plan and oversee robust physical security systems and infrastructure, including perimeters, access control, asset protection, search and screening operations
Plan and oversee staffed safety and security measures, including security guards, stewards and other deployed personnel
Lead the planning and implementation of team and referee security protocols at non-competition sites, including oversight of secure movements between sites and stadiums
Provide direct line management and leadership to the Team Security Manager, TSLOs/RSLOs and designated Venue Safety & Security Managers, ensuring clear reporting lines and operational accountability
Coordinate centrally with host cities, public security agencies and site counterparts to ensure integrated planning and consistent operational delivery
Collaborate with relevant domestic agencies and FIFA functions (e.g. medical, venue management, transport) to develop integrated emergency response, contingency and crisis management plans
Develop and implement standardised policies and procedures to ensure consistent safety and security operations across all non-competition sites
Ensure alignment between safety and security services outlined in rental or contractual agreements and the operational delivery model; establish clear audit and performance monitoring mechanisms
Manage relationships with security suppliers, conduct readiness activities and monitor performance against contractual obligations and service levels
Oversee invoicing and verification processes for safety and security suppliers in coordination with finance and administrative teams
Ensure compliance with statutory and organisational instruments and relevant FIFA regulations, including the FIFA Stadium Safety & Security Regulations (where applicable)
YOUR PROFILE
Education
University degree in security management, public safety, event management, law enforcement or a related field
Advanced training in protective security, risk management or operational planning is desirable
Experience
Minimum 5 years of experience in safety and security planning and operational delivery, preferably within major sporting events or multi-site environments
Proven experience in leading teams and managing personnel in operational environments
Demonstrated experience in secure movement planning, team protection or protective security operations
Experience working with public security authorities, private security providers and venue operators in Brazil
Experience managing supplier contracts and monitoring service delivery
Skills & Competencies
Strong leadership and line management capability, with the ability to guide, motivate and oversee multiple operational managers
Excellent stakeholder management and coordination skills across diverse site environments
Strong organisational and planning skills with attention to detail
Ability to manage complex, dynamic operational environments and make decisions under pressure
Clear written and verbal communication skills, including structured reporting
Advanced IT proficiency including MS Office suite, particularly Excel, PowerPoint and Word
Certifications & Requirements
Willingness to travel nationally and work extended hours during tournament periods
Fluency in Portuguese and English (spoken and written) is essential
Right to work in Brazil.
Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Onboarding Manager
description:
About MonetizeMore
MonetizeMore is a global leader in ad tech, seen by 300M+ people monthly. For 16 years, we've achieved double-digit growth by blending proprietary AI technology with manual optimization techniques to empower publishers. We are a culture-centric, location-independent organization that values Integrity, Enterprising, Kaizen, and Collaboration.
MonetizeMore offers location and schedule freedom to every one of its team members. That means that you would have the lifestyle autonomy to choose to work from anywhere in the world, during the time of day you prefer. This new-age work lifestyle would enable you to engineer your ideal lifestyle. Say goodbye to endless commutes, stuffy business attire, and the arbitrary 9 to 5 work-day. Take your life back into your hands by joining the MonetizeMore team
What You'll Do
As part of our Publisher Centric Team, At M2, we focus and emphasize proactive Publisher Services. As the Onboarding Manager, your role is a critical "first impression" of our organization and our ability to support our publishing partners in reaching their goals. .
You will spearhead the onboarding process for new publishers, ensuring they are equipped with the right tech, knowledge, and confidence to succeed. You are not just setting up accounts you are orchestrating a "White Glove" experience that reduces time-to-value and sets the stage for long-term retention. You also pay attention to improving our systems and processes along the way to continuously improve our service to publishers.
Responsibilities2. Client-Centric Communication & Education3. Performance Analysis & HandoffDay-today Activities
Project Management & Implementation
Lead the Lifecycle: Expertly manage the publisher journey from Sales endorsement to "Live" status. You are the project manager for the publisher's first 30-90 days
Technical Coordination: Collaborate with Account Executives and Solutions Engineers to troubleshoot setup concerns (Header Bidding, GAM, wrappers) and ensure optimal configuration
Feature Activation: Ensure all applicable M2 Tech Features are activated at launch to maximize publisher revenue immediately (KPI: Uptake %)
Kick-off & Strategy: Conduct kick-off calls to understand the publisher's specific business goals and align our implementation plan to meet them
Ambassadorship: Act as the primary champion for M2 tools and products. Provide comprehensive walkthroughs to ensure publishers are comfortable and proficient with our platform
Responsive Support: Serve as the primary point of contact for all questions during installation, providing guidance that is both technical and empathetic
Performance Reviews: Conduct thorough 7-day and 30-day post-live performance reviews. Use data to demonstrate value and identify early optimization wins
Seamless Transition: Manage a structured handoff to the Ad Optimizer and Customer Success Manager, ensuring no momentum is lost after the initial 30-day period
You are the external face of MonetizeMore for our newest partners. You thrive on variety and high-energy interaction—no two days (or publishers) are exactly alike.
External Engagement: You will constantly meet new partners, leading high-impact kickoff calls to align our tech with their specific business goals
Project Command: You project manage the entire implementation lifecycle, coordinating between the publisher and our technical teams to ensure an optimal, revenue-ready setup and accelerated scale.
Performance Ownership: You don't just "set it and forget it." You conduct data-driven 7-day and 30-day etc. performance reviews to prove value immediately
Seamless Handoff: Once the foundation is solid, you orchestrate a smooth transfer to the account management team ensuring the relationship momentum continues uninterrupted
How this role fits into the organization: This is a cornerstone role that is pivotal to our company's success.
Strategic Impact: Reporting to the Ad Ops Team Manager, you are the architect of the "First 30 Days." Since our publishers' growth is our growth, our long-term revenue goals effectively start on your desk
The "Wow" Factor: You are responsible for delivering the "White Glove" experience. You set the trajectory for retention by uncovering publisher goals early and proving that MonetizeMore is a partner, not just a vendor
Bridge Builder: You act as the vital link between Sales promises and long-term Operational success, ensuring that every new client enters our ecosystem with clarity, confidence, and a setup primed for revenue generation
Who You Are
Must Haves:
Experience: 1+ years of experience in Programmatic sell-side advertising, Customer Onboarding, or Ad Operations
Technical Knowledge: Understanding of Google Ad Manager (GAM), AdSense, Header Bidding, and Google Analytics. Experience with WordPress and debugging ad calls is a strong plus
Analytical Skills: Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and data presentation tools. You can spot trends in numbers quickly
Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills. You can command a room (virtually) and manage expectations clearly
Project Management: Demonstrated ability to manage multiple implementations simultaneously without dropping the ball
Nice to Have:
Has worked with AdSense, Google Analytics, and GAM and has extensive knowledge of Google policies and other platforms
Understands coding and has a strong tech background
Has worked with WordPress and is knowledgeable when it comes to implementing ads and debugging ad calls
Bilingual - Portuguese and Spanish are an extra bonus
What We Offer
Competitive Salary: Our salary formula adjusts to your cost of living and experience
Work remotely: Live and work wherever you like
Flexible working hours: You have the autonomy to set your own schedule
Retreats: We meet in person for company get-togethers
Career growth and learning opportunities

title: Agente Educacional
description:
O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 121 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.

Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 27 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local e é ancorada na cultura vibrante na qual se encontra. Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos num ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador.

Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.

SOBRE A VAGA
A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui nós temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Somos adeptos da mentalidade de crescimento e estamos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo e em pensar as melhores maneiras de aplicar isso em nossas escolas e inspirar nossos alunos.

Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Neste papel você será responsável, principalmente, pela operação do fluxo de entrada e saída de alunos, bem como das rotinas escolares e orientação de convivência escolar. Deve ser uma pessoa proativa, organizada, resiliente, cordial, ter facilidade em se comunicar e se relacionar com jovens e adultos e ser capaz de lidar com o ambiente dinâmico de uma escola.

RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPAIS
O que você fará:

  • Receber e registrar a entrada e saída de alunos, responsáveis e visitantes, garantindo o controle de acesso e a segurança no ambiente escolar;
  • Zelar pela boa convivência e harmonia entre os membros da comunidade escolar, intervindo quando necessário para resolver conflitos e promover um clima positivo;
  • Organizar e supervisionar os diversos setores da escola, assegurando que as instalações estejam em boas condições, ordenadas e propícias ao aprendizado;
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com outros setores da escola, garantindo a comunicação e ações coordenadas para o bom funcionamento das atividades educacionais e administrativas;
  • Executar tarefas adicionais de natureza similar e complexidade, de acordo com as demandas da escola e sob a orientação da liderança;
  • Seguir e aplicar os valores, diretrizes e procedimentos estabelecidos pela Escola, promovendo a adesão à cultura organizacional;
  • Priorizar a segurança e bem-estar dos alunos, tomando medidas para garantir um ambiente livre de riscos e perigos;
  • Acompanhar e apoiar parceiros e alunos envolvidos em atividades extracurriculares, garantindo que todas as atividades estejam alinhadas com os padrões de segurança e comportamento esperados;
  • Organizar, executar e viabilizar a logística de eventos escolares que podem ocorrer em alguns sábados letivos.

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.
REQUISITOS
Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência em escolas;
  • Simplicidade e qualidade na realização de tarefas;
  • Boa comunicação e gosto por trabalho em equipe;
  • Proatividade;
  • Organização;
  • Bom relacionamento interpessoal;
  • Entusiasmo.

O que você precisa ter:

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Experiência lidando diretamente com jovens e adolescentes.

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Qualquer candidato pode ser submetido aos procedimentos apropriados de verificação.

Visit our careers site for more information;

title: Expert Network Project Coordinator
description:
Company Description

M3 USA is at the forefront of healthcare innovation, offering digital solutions across healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, and more. Since our inception in 2000, we've seen remarkable growth, fueled by our mission to utilize the internet for a healthier world and more efficient healthcare systems.

Our success is anchored in our trusted digital platforms that engage physician communities globally, facilitating impactful medical education, precise job placement, and insightful market research. M3 USA prides itself on a dynamic and innovative work environment where every team member contributes to global health advancements.

Joining M3 USA means being part of a dedicated team striving to make a significant difference in healthcare. We provide a unique opportunity for you to be at the cutting edge of healthcare innovation, shaping the future in a meaningful career. Embrace the chance to drive change with M3 USA.

Due to continued growth, we are hiring for an Expert Network Project Coordinator at M3 Global Research, an M3 company.

About the Business Unit:  

M3 Global Research, part of M3 Inc., provides the most comprehensive and highest quality market research recruitment and support services available to the industry with relationships reaching respondents in more than 70 countries worldwide.

M3 Global Research maintains ISO 26362 and 27001 certifications with the highest quality data collection and project management capabilities that cover the spectrum of quantitative and qualitative techniques utilized today. M3 services incorporate all of the most advanced statistical and attitudinal methodologies allowing clients to provide world-class offerings and support services to their end-client customers throughout multiple industry sectors. 

Job Description

The Expert Network Project Coordinator assists the Client Service team with day-to-day management of market research studies, to ensure all projects successfully complete on time, within the budget and in accordance with the client specs, while meeting and exceeding client expectations.

This position is one of the key team members in the execution of the quantitative/qualitative projects, and is responsible for field management and sample strategies, and will be accountable for coordinating with respondents, vendors, and clients. They will assist with the set-up of the study and other project requirements as needed.

Key Responsibilities: 

  • Manage and control sampling and fieldwork, including screener review for allocated projects.
  • Execute end to end project related tasks which could include (but not exclusively) link setup, link testing, languages requests, desk research, quality/audit checks, set up and delivery of study invitations, manage exclusion lists, M3 Wallet approvals, invoicing and cost reconciliation.
  • Address Support Team and other stakeholders' requests in a timely manner.
  • Attend meetings with PMs regarding assigned projects to ensure project specifications, client needs, timelines, and responsibilities are understood.
  • Takes notes and fill checklists during key meetings and share them with the attendee afterwards
  • Host market research pretest/pilot interviews for clients, and ensure interviews are conducted on time and as planned. This will require direct client interactions.
  • Build, update and track customized fielding plans for all projects as needed.
  • Proactively seek alternative fieldwork strategies and find solutions to address response rates and costs on each project.
  • Manage and control of the partners on quantitative projects throughout the life cycle of the project, ensuring that M3 achieves and exceeds client's expectations.
  • Track, monitor and report on sampling performance.
  • Support PMs with invoicing ensuring that projects are closed and ready for invoicing in a timely manner.
  • Alert the Project Manager of a project when a fieldwork strategy is failing or getting off track or there is a quality concern and work together to find alternative solutions.
  • Design and request multichannel recruitment methodologies for allocated projects, which could include (but not exclusively) email campaigns, calling, desk research, text messages, online advertisement, referral schemes, forums, blogs, patient groups and associations networking and social media.
  • Scheduling respondents for market research interviews, including creating the scheduler in the system, communication with respondents, coordinating shared moderator schedules, manual entry in MR system and moderator scheduling platforms.
  • Help respondents log in to qualitative platforms for their interviews and troubleshoot any issues.

Qualifications

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated knowledge of English grammar rules
  • Strong Microsoft Office skills (Excel) and quick learner of new technologies/software
  • Must have basic math skills, with the ability to calculate incidence rate, response rates profit, etc
  • Interest / natural curiosity or previous experience /exposure within the healthcare space
  • Exhibit strong critical thinking skills and take initiative to improve skills and troubleshoot proactively with PM using all available resources to support project success
  • Ability to work autonomously and in a team environment to successfully meet study specific and departmental objectives
  • Self-motivated and able to (re)prioritize tasks throughout the workday
  • Exceptional time management, organizational skills, attention to detail and ability to multitask
  • Fluent in English

Additional Information

*M3 reserves the right to change this job description to meet the business needs of the organization

This position will support US EST Hours 

We kindly ask that you please submit all resumes in English.

description:
Welcome to the good side of tech
You might have heard about us, but with a different name: Doctoralia. It all started 12 years ago when we asked ourselves: is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted: treating patients. We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 90 million patients trust us every month. 300k+ specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2.500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup-mindset we started with over 10 years ago.

At Docplanner Tech we are a diverse group of over 400 people working in Engineering, Data, and Product teams. We are responsible for building the product for all locations. Many of us have been here for over 5 years, yet we still welcome each new person with great joy and excitement.
We could tell you about us, but we will let our reviews on Glassdoor speak for themselves. In case you'd like to see how it feels to be 100% yourself at work, here's a video of us.

Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.
We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that taking the diversity of human experience into account makes a better healthcare experience for all . We're not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self, and that includes not coming to the office at all if you prefer not to, as we're 100% remote friendly.
Job Description
Through a diverse range of services, we are able to serve different audiences: our marketplace, which allows patients to schedule and evaluate appointments and doctors at any time of the day or night; and our SaaS system (Software as a Service) aimed at optimizing office management, patient flow and online bookings. All this through an internet platform and our iOS/Android apps.
We are looking for a Product Designer for software modernization who will be responsible for creating and improving user interfaces, from research and ideation to final delivery, focusing on usability and user experience. This professional will work on the conception of digital products, prototyping, testing, and iterating solutions, always seeking to enhance the interaction between the user and technology. They will also work in multidisciplinary teams, collaborating with developers and Product Managers to ensure product quality and efficiency.

Collaboration: Work closely with product, development, and other teams to ensure the delivery of high-quality solutions.
Continuous optimization: Monitor product performance, identify areas for improvement, and propose solutions to optimize the user experience.

Skills:

Understanding and evaluation of flows and bottleneck identification.

Portfolio demonstrating product design skills.

About the project:
As a Webflow Developer, you will be responsible for bringing high-fidelity designs to life, building and maintaining a scalable, performance-oriented web ecosystem. How you'll contribute
Design, build, and maintain responsive, high-fidelity websites and landing pages using Webflow, including the Designer, CMS, and Interactions features.
Translate design specs and brand guidelines into pixel-perfect, accessible Webflow implementations.
Structure and manage Webflow CMS collections to support dynamic, content-driven pages that are easy for non-technical teammates to update.
Build reusable symbols, components, and utility classes within Webflow to maintain consistency and streamline future development.
Implement animations, micro-interactions, and scroll-based effects using Webflow Interactions and Animations.
Write custom code (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) via Webflow's embed elements when native functionality doesn't meet requirements.
Integrate Webflow with third-party tools and services (e.g., Zapier, Make, HubSpot, analytics platforms, form handlers) to extend site functionality.
Optimize site performance, SEO, and Core Web Vitals within the Webflow environment.
Manage staging, publishing, and hosting workflows within Webflow, including domain configuration and 301 redirects.
Collaborate with designers, marketers, and backend engineers to ensure the web experience aligns with broader product and brand goals.
This would make you the ideal candidate
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
5+ Years of experience working in building and shipping websites, with meaningful hands-on experience in Webflow.
Deep understanding of Webflow's Designer, CMS, Interactions, and hosting/publishing features.
Strong proficiency in HTML, CSS, and responsive design principles; able to troubleshoot layout and styling issues quickly.
Working knowledge of JavaScript for custom functionality, third-party integrations, and embed-based solutions within Webflow.
Experience structuring Webflow CMS collections and reference fields to support scalable, content-rich sites.
Familiarity with SEO best practices, site performance optimization, and web accessibility standards (WCAG).
Experience integrating Webflow with external platforms and APIs (e.g., Zapier, Make, HubSpot, Segment, Google Tag Manager).
Comfort with version control concepts and collaborative workflows; experience with Git-based workflows or Webflow's staging/publishing model.
Solid design and UX sensibility; able to interpret design specs and raise questions when something doesn't feel right.
Advanced English Level is required for this role, as you will work with US clients. Effective communication in English is essential to deliver the best solutions to our clients and expand your horizons.

We would love to hear from you if you are eager to make an impact and join a collaborative team that values creativity and expertise.

title: Especialista de Operações
description:
Descrição da vaga
Por que trabalhar conosco?
Porque somos a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão em prática fazendo a diferença nos 178 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 26 milhões de pessoas. Somos inspirados a transformar o futuro e melhorar a forma que as pessoas vivem. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos a nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de dezenas de cidades, levando saúde, dignidade e bem-estar.
A Concessionária
A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.
Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizará o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.
Programa Respeito dá o Tom
O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.
A partir de 2020 passou por uma revisão e seu objetivo foi reconfigurado: espelhar a população negra em todos os níveis hierárquicos.
Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Apoiar nos projetos de abastecimento de água e transporte de esgoto;
Identificar gargalos e propor soluções de melhorias de maneira rápida e eficiente;
Manter interface do COI com a unidade de negócio e com os outros setores (apoio com modelagem, TI, perdas, comunicação, despacho e serviços);
Apoiar a unidade de negócio nos eventos, seja na busca pela causa raiz ou na organização do evento;
Garantir que o time interno entenda e conheça o abastecimento de cada unidade de negócio.
Requisitos e qualificações
Ensino superior completo Engenharia ou áreas afins;
Pacote Office avançado, com ênfase em Excel;
Desejável conhecimento de Power BI e Qgis;
Conhecimentos Técnicos de Hidráulica de redes pressurizadas.
Conhecimentos Técnicos de Sistemas de abastecimento de água.
Técnicas de pitometria.
Habilidade de Leitura e interpretação de curvas de perda de carga.
Instrumentação de campo (medidores de vazão, pressão, dataloggers).
Conhecimeto de Softwares de modelagem hidráulica (EPANET, InfoWater, WaterGEMS).
Noções de GIS.

Assistência médica;

Seguro de vida;

AE Orienta - Aconselhamento Psicológico, Financeiro, Jurídico e social;

#Rio

A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos.
