title: Consultor(a) Sênior de Gestão de Mudança
description:
A NEORIS, agora parte da EPAM, é uma Aceleradora Digital que ajuda empresas a darem o próximo passo em direção ao futuro. Temos mais de 20 anos de experiência como parceiros digitais de algumas das maiores empresas do mundo. Somos mais de 4.000 profissionais em 11 países, com uma cultura multicultural e de startup, na qual cultivamos a inovação e o aprendizado contínuo para criar soluções de alto valor para nossos clientes. 

Localidade: Rio de Janeiro 

Modelo de atuação: Híbrido - Necessidade pontuais 

Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de uma Consultora Sênior de Gestão de Mudança Organizacional para atuar em um programa de transformação SAP de alta complexidade, envolvendo redesenho de processos, adoção de melhores práticas e rollout de SAP S/4HANA. Procuramos uma profissional com forte capacidade de articulação executiva, entrega hands-on, governança de stakeholders e domínio metodológico em Change Management aplicado a programas de tecnologia de missão crítica.

Neste papel estratégico, você será responsável por estruturar e orquestrar a estratégia de mudança, promovendo o alinhamento entre áreas, mitigando resistências, acelerando a adoção e sustentando a nova cultura operacional.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Liderar a estratégia de Gestão de Mudança da transformação SAP, abrangendo comunicação, engajamento, readiness, treinamento e gestão de impactos organizacionais.
  • Realizar diagnósticos de maturidade e análises de impacto (OIA – Organizational Impact Assessment) para identificar gaps comportamentais, operacionais e culturais.
  • Preparar e conduzir rituais executivos, Steering Committees e touchpoints com áreas de negócio, garantindo alinhamento entre C-Level, PMO, TI e frentes funcionais SAP.
  • Desenvolver e implementar planos de comunicação multicanal, traduzindo temas técnicos SAP para mensagens claras, pragmáticas e orientadas ao negócio.
  • Estruturar e gerir o plano de treinamento SAP (Training Strategy, TNA – Training Needs Assessment, cronograma e execução), assegurando aderência ao modelo de rollout.
  • Liderar a gestão da mudança durante cutover e hiper-care, garantindo readiness da organização, mitigação de riscos e aderência ao novo operating model.
  • Atuar como ponte entre as equipes funcionais SAP (Financeiro, Logística, IS-U, etc.) e as áreas de negócio na interpretação dos impactos dos novos processos.
  • Elaborar dashboards executivos de Change Management, KPIs e indicadores de adoção.
  • Garantir alinhamento às metodologias internas (SAP Activate, Clean Core, TAO quando aplicável) e melhores práticas globais de GMO.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada em Gestão de Mudança para projetos SAP, em fases de implementação, rollout ou migração para SAP S/4HANA.
  • Senioridade para atuar em ambientes complexos, multigeográficos e politicamente sensíveis.
  • Forte capacidade de comunicação executiva, com narrativa clara e estruturação de mensagens estratégicas.
  • Fluência em inglês e espanhol para condução de workshops, reports e governança multinacional.
  • Vivência com frameworks de Change Management (ADKAR, Prosci, Kotter, etc.), combinados com práticas de transformação digital.
  • Experiência em gestão de stakeholders e condução de rituais executivos em grandes organizações.
  • Capacidade de traduzir temas tecnológicos em impactos de negócio e comportamentais.

Diferenciais

  • Atuação em programas de transformação multinacionais ou multicountry rollouts.
  • Background híbrido (Processos, PMO, Comunicação Interna, Treinamento, Cultura).

title: Executivo(a) Key Account
description:
Nosso modo de fazer no time


Transforme sua carreira com o iFood Somos uma empresa brasileira de tecnologia referência na América Latina. Por meio de soluções inovadoras, conectamos milhares de restaurantes a milhões de consumidores diariamente com uma média de 100 milhões de pedidos mensais. Além do delivery de comida, também somos Mercado, Farmácia e Pet. Temos também o iFood Pago, nossa Fintech, que engloba o iFood Benefícios, o vale alimentação e refeição do iFood e o próprio iFood Pago, o banco do restaurante. Junte-se a nós e faça parte de uma equipe que está sempre à frente com tecnologia de ponta e inovação constante.

Seu Cardápio Diário

  • Gestão 360º de Contas (General Management): Liderar o plano estratégico (Joint Business Plan) dos maiores parceiros do canal, influenciando desde a operação em loja e integração técnica até o sortimento de produtos e pricing.
  • Visão de Canal: Atuar com foco macro, garantindo que as estratégias aplicadas na sua carteira gerem valor e sirvam de benchmark para todo o ecossistema.
  • Análise de Dados e IA: Interpretar grandes volumes de dados para gerar insights de negócios. Utilizar ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial para otimizar processos, criar discussões de alto nível com parceiros e prever tendências de consumo.
  • Rentabilização e Alavancas: Gerir budgets de investimento, negociar exclusividades e garantir a rentabilidade da carteira através da venda consultiva de produtos do ecossistema iFood.
  • Interface Estratégica: Conectar-se com diretores e stakeholders seniores para alinhar prioridades e reportar o desempenho nacional do canal.
  • Liderança e Protagonismo de Categoria: Atuar com mindset de liderança, assumindo a frente das discussões estratégicas do canal. Ser a referência técnica e de negócios para o time, influenciando a estratégia da categoria muito além da sua própria carteira.

Ingredientes que buscamos

  • Formação: Graduação completa em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Marketing ou áreas correlatas.
  • Perfil Empreendedor: Mentalidade de "donos do negócio", proatividade para resolver problemas complexos e visão de futuro.
  • Forte Capacidade Analítica: Habilidade avançada para interpretar dados, criar diagnósticos e transformá-los em planos de ação (Storytelling com dados).
  • Negociação Consultiva de Alto Nível: Experiência em lidar com interlocutores de grandes redes.
  • Adaptabilidade e Velocidade: Conforto para trabalhar em um ambiente de escala e inovação constante.
  • Comunicação e Relações Interpessoais: Habilidade excepcional de comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de adaptar o discurso para diferentes públicos.
  • Experiência: Sólida trajetória em Gestão de Grandes Contas (Key Account Management), Gestão de Categoria ou Gerência de Produto/Trade no varejo.
  • Ferramentas: Domínio de Excel (avançado), ferramentas de BI (Power BI/Looker) e familiaridade com ferramentas de produtividade (Slack/Salesforce).
  • Background no Setor: Experiência prévia em grandes players do mercado (Varejo ou Indústria) ou grandes Marketplaces.
  • Familiaridade com IA: Conhecimento em aplicação de agentes de IA ou automação de processos analíticos.

Sobre nós


No iFood, acreditamos na força da diversidade para gerar #Inovação e atingir #Resultados incríveis, por isso, não fazemos distinção para candidatos com deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça/etnia, idade, origem, constituição familiar e estética. Temos grupos compostos por foodlovers voluntários, onde falamos sobre Raça, Gênero, LGBTQI+ e PcD. Queremos ser a empresa onde pessoas escolham como lugar para se desenvolver e contribuir para a realização de sonhos, #AllTogether.

Conheça nossas iniciativas →

Você tem fome de que?


Nós, FoodLovers, temos fome de inovação e resultado. Buscamos sempre fazer o nosso melhor, pensando "fora da caixa" e atuando com agilidade e responsabilidade Temos fome de diversidade, conhecimento e compartilhamento. O resultado de toda nossa dedicação é refletido em pesquisas de clima realizadas com nossos colaboradores. Em 2022, a Log-In conquistou, pelo segundo ano consecutivo, o selo de Great Place to Work(GPTW). No mesmo ano, entramos no Ranking GPTW de melhores empresas para trabalhar do Espírito Santo e, em 2023, no Ranking de melhores empresas para trabalhar no Rio de Janeiro.

Uma conquista que nos orgulha e nos incentiva a continuar fazendo de tudo para ser um lugar cada vez melhor para as pessoas.

Nossa jornada também é marcada pela inovação, responsabilidade e pelo compromisso com o meio ambiente.

Venha fazer parte do nosso time. Será um prazer ter você aqui com a gente

Responsabilidades e atribuições

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES


Ao Cozinheiro compete:

  • Cumprir e fazer cumprir todas as ordens ou determinações que receber dos seus superiores, relativas aos serviços de sua especialidade;
  • Responder pelo rancho em serviço diário de cozinha, esmerando-se para que o seu preparo seja feito o mais higiênico e escrupulosamente possível;
  • Fiscalizar os gêneros entregues na cozinha, providenciando o seu transporte, guarda e conservação;
  • Dirigir pessoalmente a distribuição dos alimentos durante as refeições;
  • Zelar pela conservação, limpeza e asseio de todas as dependências da cozinha, bem como dos utensílios;
  • Usar e exigir que os demais usem, igualmente, a indumentária apropriada e uniformes apropriados aos serviços culinários, mantendo-a sempre limpa e asseada;
  • Comunicar ao Comandante toda e qualquer suspeita acerca do seu estado de saúde e de seus auxiliares, como também toda e qualquer falta disciplinar acorrida;
  • Assinar cautelas de responsabilidade do material entregue para os serviços de suas atribuições responsabilizando-se pelas faltas ocorridas;
  • Executar as fainas gerais de limpeza da cozinha e dos demais utensílios;
  • Executar o transporte de gêneros do paiol e câmaras frigoríficas para a cozinha;
  • Apresentar-se ao Imediato após o término diário dos serviços, a fim de receber ordens para o dia seguinte;
  • Comunicar ao Imediato toda e qualquer anormalidade verificada nos serviços que lhe estão afetos.
  • Manter devidamente conservados, limpos e em ótimas condições de higiene os paióis de mantimentos, câmaras frigoríficas e suas dependências e geladeiras;
  • Receber, controlar e guardar todos os gêneros destinados ao abastecimento da embarcação, fazendo a sua arrumação nos paióis e câmaras frigoríficas ou geladeiras, de modo a evitar qualquer deterioração;
  • Fazer a saída, diariamente e de acordo com o cardápio, dos gêneros secos e frescos, destinados ao preparo da alimentação, verificando o estado de conservação dos mesmos, pesando-os e conferindo-os;
  • Não permitir, terminantemente, que se fume nos paióis, câmaras ou antecâmaras frigoríficas;
  • Providenciar para que a carne arrumada nas câmaras frigoríficas ou geladeiras não fique em contato com peixes, nem estivada englobadamente, devendo ficar separada uma parte da outra, de modo a permitir a livre circulação entre elas;
  • Receber e entregar ao Comandante, após conferidas as validades, a qualidade, o número, peso e espécie, as notas de entrega de gêneros;
  • Proceder o balanço dos paióis e câmaras frigoríficas, sempre que lhe for determinado;
  • Comunicar aos seus superiores quaisquer irregularidades ou ocorrências que se verificar nos serviços a seu cargo, bem como mantê-los sempre a par do movimento e funcionamento dos paióis e câmaras frigoríficas;
  • Ter sob sua guarda e responsabilidade de todas as andainas de roupas de cama da embarcação, toalhas de mesa, pratos, panelas e talheres.
  • Não fornecer qualquer material ou gênero sem ordem específica.

title: Analista de TI Sênior
description:
Somos o maior ressegurador do Brasil. Com mais de 80 anos de experiência, atuamos nas principais linhas de negócios em resseguros e contamos com uma equipe altamente qualificada, pronta para inovar e oferecer os melhores produtos e serviços ao mercado.
Estamos com 1 vaga de Analista de TI Sênior, com foco em Administração de Redes. Confira os detalhes abaixo:
FORMAÇÃO ACADÊMICA
Necessário Superior completo em Engenharia de Redes, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
Certificações desejáveis: CCNA, CCNP, Fortinet NSE, CompTIA Network+, ITIL, Azure/AWS Network Engineer Associate.
Desejável pós-graduação em Infraestrutura de TI, Segurança da Informação ou Engenharia de Conectividade.
EXPERIÊNCIA/CONHECIMENTOS
Imprescindível experiência em administração e suporte de redes corporativas LAN/WAN/Wi-Fi, em ambientes on-premises e cloud;
Conhecimento avançado em roteamento, switching, firewalls, NAT, VLANs, QoS e VPNs;
Vivência com ferramentas de monitoramento e automação de rede (Zabbix, SolarWinds, PRTG, Ansible);
Experiência em ambientes híbridos e multicloud, com integração entre redes locais e provedores cloud;
Conhecimento de protocolos de rede (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, SNMP, BGP, OSPF);
Familiaridade com segurança de rede, criptografia, IDS/IPS, segmentação e controle de acesso;
Capacidade de diagnóstico e troubleshooting de incidentes complexos de conectividade;
Vivência em ambientes corporativos críticos e regulados, com requisitos de alta disponibilidade e compliance;
Familiaridade com soluções de rede e segurança Cisco, Palo Alto e Trend Micro;
Necessário Inglês técnico intermediário (para leitura de documentação e interface com fornecedores globais).
MISSÃO DA POSIÇÃO
Garantir a operação estável, segura e eficiente das redes de comunicação de dados e voz do IRB(Re), assegurando disponibilidade, desempenho e confiabilidade dos serviços de conectividade corporativa. É o responsável técnico pela infraestrutura de rede, abrangendo LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, firewalls e equipamentos de comunicação, suportando as operações do negócio e garantindo conformidade com as políticas de segurança e governança de TI.
Assegurar a continuidade e a resiliência das redes corporativas, promovendo padronização, automação e melhoria contínua da infraestrutura de conectividade que sustenta os sistemas críticos e o ambiente híbrido do IRB(Re).
PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES
Gestão e Operação de Ambientes
Administrar e monitorar a rede corporativa LAN/WAN/Wi-Fi, em ambientes on-premises e cloud, garantindo disponibilidade, estabilidade e desempenho;
Configurar, manter e otimizar switches, roteadores, access points, firewalls, balanceadores e VPNs;
Monitorar a latência, throughput e integridade dos enlaces de rede, propondo ações corretivas e preventivas;
Executar rotinas de backup e restauração de configurações de rede;
Gerenciar e documentar o inventário de equipamentos de rede, seus contratos de manutenção;
Apoiar times de Service Desk e Infraestrutura na resolução de incidentes relacionados à conectividade;
Garantir o cumprimento de SLAs de disponibilidade e performance de rede, com reportes regulares à Governança de TI.
Implementação e Melhoria Contínua
Planejar e executar projetos de implantação, atualização e expansão de rede, em alinhamento com Engenharia & Plataforma;
Definição de escopo técnico para projetos de infraestrutura de redes, visando escalabilidade e alta disponibilidade dos serviços, garantindo o alinhamento entre requisitos técnicos e necessidades de negócio;
Avaliar novas tecnologias e padrões de conectividade (SD-WAN, Wi-Fi 6, 5G, Zero Trust Network Access);
Automatizar tarefas de configuração e monitoração com uso de ferramentas de gerenciamento de rede e scripts (Ansible, Python, SNMP, etc.);
Apoiar a integração de ambientes on-premises e cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP) garantindo conectividade segura;
Participar da definição de arquiteturas de rede resilientes e escaláveis, em conjunto com Arquitetura Corporativa;
Documentar diagramas, topologias e fluxos de rede no repositório corporativo de arquitetura;
Realizar testes de carga, failover e redundância em enlaces críticos.
Segurança, Governança e Compliance
Operar e gerenciar ferramentas de segurança, como: Endpoint Security, NGFW, PAM, WAF, Cloud Email Security, NAC, DNS Security, de acordo as diretrizes do CISO;
Monitorar e responder a alertas de segurança de rede, incidentes e vulnerabilidades, em colaboração com o time de Cyber Service;
Apoiar auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo evidências de controles e conformidade (LGPD, SUSEP, SOX);
Assegurar a execução de atualizações de firmware e patches de segurança nos dispositivos de rede;
Gerenciar logs e trilhas de auditoria de equipamentos e soluções de rede;
Apoiar o planejamento e execução de planos de continuidade e recuperação de desastres (DRP) para infraestrutura de rede.
BENEFÍCIOS
Assistência médica
Assistência odontológica
Auxílio creche
Participação nos Lucros ou Resultados
Previdência privada
Seguro de vida
Vale alimentação e/ou Vale-refeição

- Organizar a passagem de turno e preencher reports operacionais diários

- Conhecimentos de Microsoft Excel.

title: HR Training Analyst
description:
Position: HR Training Analyst
Location: Barra da Tijuca, Rio de Janeiro
About Us
MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.
For over 56 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide.
Job Purpose
The HR Training & Personnel Logistics Analyst is responsible for ensuring full compliance of offshore personnel with mandatory training requirements, managing training logistics, and maintaining accurate certification records in DRAKE System.
The role also supports HR strategy implementation, training governance, personnel logistics coordination, and operational workforce readiness in alignment with corporate policies and project needs.
Key Responsibilities
Ensure that all offshore personnel hold valid mandatory training and certifications required for offshore deployment;
Coordinate all logistics arrangements for trainings scheduled in the DRAKE System;
Maintain strict control and timely updates of training and certification records in DRAKE;
Provide HR expertise in developing and implementing training-related policies, processes, and improvement actions according to business needs;
Interpret, apply, and uphold corporate policies and legal requirements with strong customer focus and best practices;
Apply an integrated approach when managing the employee mandatory training cycle (training matrix, gap analysis, deviation notices, certifications, training providers, and budget control) to effectively support Projects and Operations;
Monitor and support the local execution of HR Training policies, procedures, and processes;
Assist in managing the training budget, including creation and follow-up of Purchase Requisitions (PRs) for all training-related expenses;
Coordinate feedback from personnel regarding training provider performance and recommend improvements to management;
Support audits and evaluations of training service providers;
Provide operational support to the Personnel Logistics team, including weekend on-call coverage and emergency demands when required;
Control operational activities related to personnel departure, mobilization, and allocation.
Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field;
Previous experience in offshore operations, oil & gas, or maritime environment preferred;
Experience managing training matrices and certification control systems (DRAKE knowledge is an advantage);
Knowledge of Brazilian labor and maritime regulations is desirable;
Fluent English (minimum intermediate level);
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities;
Proactive profile with strong interface capability between HR and Operations.
Benefits
Meal and food allowances;
Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, no co-pay);
Life Insurance;
Annual Bonus;
Private Pension Plan;
Childcare Allowance.
Note
This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.
MISC is committed to diversity and inclusion and welcomes applications from professionals of all backgrounds.

title: Coordenador de SDR
description:
Descrição da empresa

Quer trabalhar na maior plataforma de saúde do MUNDO?
Somos a Doctoralia, empresa do grupo Docplanner, e estamos presentes em 13 países, sendo responsáveis por atender mais de 55 milhões de pacientes e processar mais de 17 milhões de agendamentos de consultas por mês
Atualmente, temos mais de 2 milhões de profissionais da saúde em nossa base, somando aproximadamente 14 milhões de avaliações de pacientes até hoje.
Ajudando as pessoas a viverem vidas mais longas e saudáveis
Através de uma diversificada gama de serviços, conseguimos atender a diferentes públicos: marketplace, que permite que pacientes agendem e avaliem consultas e médicos a qualquer hora do dia ou da noite; e sistema SaaS (Software as a Service) voltado para otimização da gestão do consultório, fluxo de pacientes e realização de consultas online. Tudo isso através de plataforma na internet ou aplicativo para iOS ou Android.Na Doctoralia, buscamos um(a) líder com energia, visão estratégica e forte orientação por dados para coordenar nosso time de pré-vendas inbound. A pessoa será responsável por garantir a eficiência da jornada dos nossos leads, com foco em performance e excelência operacional

Descrição do emprego

Na Doctoralia, buscamos um líder com energia, visão estratégica e forte orientação por dados para coordenar nosso time de pré-vendas outbound. A pessoa será responsável por garantir a eficiência da jornada dos nossos leads, com foco em performance e excelência operacional.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Liderar um time de 4 a 6 SDRs, promovendo desenvolvimento contínuo e foco em alta performance;
  • Garantir a eficiência da operação outbound, desde o lead MQL até a qualificação e agendamento de reuniões;
  • Monitorar indicadores críticos como conversão, tempo de resposta, volume por canal e no-show;
  • Revisar fluxos de cadência, roteiros e abordagens de contato, propondo melhorias com base em dados;
  • Realizar escutas, feedbacks, treinamentos e roleplays com o time;
  • Atuar de forma estratégica com Marketing, Vendas e áreas de suporte para otimizar o funil de qualificação;
  • Propor melhorias de processos e fluxos comerciais, com base em dados e performance do time;
  • Garantir a integração e evolução dos novos SDRs, fortalecendo cultura de aprendizado contínuo;
  • Ser ponte entre o time de pré-vendas e demais áreas, como Marketing, Vendas e Operações;
  • Utilizar ferramentas como Salesforce e Outreach para gestão de performance e automação.

Você vai se conectar com...

  • Gerente de Pré-Vendas (liderança direta)
  • Executivos de Vendas, Marketing, RevOps e TA
  • Outras lideranças da área comercial

Qualificações

O que buscamos

  • Experiência sólida com liderança de times SDR ou vendas;
  • Vivência prática liderado times em operações outbound B2B;
  • Forte capacidade analítica e tomada de decisão com base em dados;
  • Boa comunicação, poder de influência e espírito de colaboração;
  • Conhecimento em CRM e ferramentas de automação (Salesforce, Outreach, etc.);
  • Formação superior completa.

Diferenciais que somam pontos

  • Já ter atuado como SDR antes de assumir a liderança;
  • Experiência em empresas SaaS, tech ou startups;
  • Ter estruturado processos de pré-vendas do zero;
  • Inglês intermediário/avançado.

Informações Adicionais

Aqui na DOC, valorizamos e celebramos a diversidade em todas as suas formas. Estamos empenhados em atrair talentos diversos, sem importar gênero, raça, orientação sexual, religião, nacionalidade, idade ou condição física. Estamos comprometidos em construir uma equipe inclusiva e acolhedora, onde cada indivíduo possa fazer bonito, contribuindo com seu melhor;

  • Nossa jornada de trabalho é de segunda à sexta, das 9h às 18h;
  • Precisou trabalhar além do seu horário habitual? Temos Banco de horas para que use essas horas como folga, posteriormente;
  • Para o deslocamento para o escritório, oferecemos Vale-Transporte;
  • Oferecemos Vale-Refeição/Alimentação através do Cartão iFood, o cartão de benefícios mais flexível do Brasil, no valor de R$708,54 mensal;
  • Oferecemos Assistência Médica através da SulAmérica e Assistência Odontológica via Porto Seguro;
  • Nossas Licenças são diferenciadas por aqui: em caso de falecimento de pessoas amadas, oferecemos 10 dias; caso seu Pet venha a óbito, tem 2 dias. Casou? 7 dias de descanso O bebê chegou? Oferecemos 30 dias para o papai e 6 meses para a mamãe;
  • Oferecemos, também, acesso a serviços de acompanhamento nutricional, desconto em suplementos, medicamentos e muito mais;
  • Para as mamães e  papais 'de plantão', temos o Auxílio Creche;
  • Disponibilizamos o app iFeel, de conforto emocional, que combina psicologia tradicional com inteligência artificial, te ajudando naqueles dias mais difíceis;
  • E a vida fitness? Oferecemos Gympass para você;
  • Achou que seu Pet ficaria de fora? Claro que não Oferecemos Plano Pet estendendo o cuidado, também, para o seu animalzinho;
  • Stock Options - elegível após 6 meses de casa (5 anos de carência) - SIM Você vira sócio da empresa;
  • Temos um Clube de Parcerias robusto, com convênios e descontos que vão desde à instituições de ensino, como faculdades e idiomas, até benefícios bancários exclusivos;
  • Benefícios Creditas: rede de empréstimo consignado, elegível para solicitar após 6 meses da admissão;
  • Desconto no Cinemark, no app de delivery iFood e no Clube iFood;

Modelo de trabalho - híbrido (RJ): Você que mora no RJ e região metropolitana trabalhará alguns dias em nosso escritório no Santo Cristo/RJ e de casa (a combinar com sua liderança).

Etapas do processo seletivo

  1. Triagem de currículos - analisamos seu perfil com base nos requisitos da vaga e no momento atual da área.
  2. Entrevista com Talent Acquisition (por vídeo) - bate-papo por vídeo com nosso time de Recrutamento para conhecer suas experiências, avaliar competências e entender o fit com a cultura. Também é sua oportunidade de tirar dúvidas e conhecer mais sobre a empresa
  3. Avaliação Comportamental - aplicamos um teste rápido (5 a 7 min) que nos ajuda a entender melhor seu perfil comportamental.
  4. Entrevista com a Liderança - conversa mais aprofundada com sua liderança direta. Avaliamos aspectos técnicos, expectativas e seguimos aprofundando o alinhamento com a vaga.
  5. Entrevista presencial na nossa sede + Case prático / Teste técnico - etapa final Um momento para demonstrar sua forma de pensar e tomar decisões na prática.
    Você será avaliado(a) pela Gerente de Pré-Vendas (liderança direta), pelo time de People e pelo Head B2B.
  6. Oferta e início imediato - Tudo certo? Seguimos com a proposta formal e, após a sua aprovação, você já poderá iniciar com a gente

Em todas as etapas fornecemos o feedback do processo.

title: Senior Operational Auditor- Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat family relocation package.
Overview
We are seeking an operational auditor with substantial auditing or operational experience in Upstream or Downstream to join Internal Auditing Organization.
The Internal Auditing is responsible for helping organizations to accomplish their objectives by bringing a systematic and disciplined approach to evaluate and improve the effectiveness of the organization's risk management, control, and governance processes.
Your primary role will be to lead and oversee the audit team while serving as the primary liaison for clients, ensuring strong relationships and high-quality delivery throughout the engagement.
Key Responsibilities
As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:
Establish the objective and scope of the audit engagement.
Identify key risks and controls within the business and operational processes under review.
Develop comprehensive risk-based audit programs.
Responsible for the audit team and will be overseeing assistant auditors.
Discuss concerns and issues with the audit client, draft field memorandums, and update client and Internal Auditing Management on progress of the audit.
Execute risk-based audit procedures in alignment with company policies and international standards.
Prepare audit reports.
Deliver presentations to client management at the audit opening and closing meetings.
Provide on-the-job training and mentoring to less experienced staff.
Evaluate the performance and capabilities of the assisting staff auditors.
Provide assurance and consulting activities on internal controls as requested.
Minimum Requirements
As a successful candidate, you will hold a bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, engineering, or another related field; an advanced degree is a plus.
You will have a minimum of 7 years of experience in auditing, engineering, or plant operations within the oil and gas industry or from one of the Big Four Auditing firms (Deloitte, PwC, EY and KPMG)
You should hold at least one professional certification, such as the Certified Internal Auditor, Certified Public Accountant, Chartered Accountant, or a similar professional credentials.
You must demonstrate excellent oral and written communication skills in the English language and excellent presentation and interpersonal skills.
You should be flexible to travel within the Kingdom and/or outside the Kingdom to conduct audit and consulting engagements.
Working environment
Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.
At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world's biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.
We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.
Aramco energizes the world economy.
Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world's largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer. With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco's value to society.
Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations' spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom's vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.
We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

Apex is a growing agency focused on Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), aimed at boosting client sales without increasing ad budgets. We work with top e-commerce brands to enhance their websites, using data and proven strategies to drive growth.

With a solid record of delivering results, we combine technical skills with a focus on improving user experience. As we expand, we offer opportunities to work with a talented team, solving challenges and applying advanced CRO methods.

If you're looking to make a difference and help e-commerce businesses grow, alongside a team of driven professionals, consider joining the Apex team.

About the Role 

The Conversion Rate Optimization Expert is responsible for enhancing the performance of our clients' websites by implementing data-driven strategies that maximize their conversion rates. 

This position plays a key role in analyzing user behavior, identifying optimization opportunities, and implementing changes to improve overall site performance. You will collaborate closely with copywriters, designers, web developers, and other team members.

Your responsibilities will include developing Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) strategies for our clients, auditing their websites to identify optimization opportunities, running A/B and multivariate tests to determine the changes needed, and working with our internal teams to execute, monitor, and further improve the results of the optimizations implemented. 

Mission Statement:

The primary mission of our Conversion Rate Optimization Expert is to drive measurable improvements in our clients' e-commerce website performance by implementing tailored CRO strategies. This will involve working directly on optimizing brand websites and using data-driven insights to enhance user experiences, maximize conversion rates, and deliver real business growth to our clients.

General responsibilities:

The responsibilities of our Conversion Rate Optimization Expert include, but are not limited to:

  • Developing and implementing tailored, data-driven backend CRO strategies for our agency's clients to enhance their website performance and maximize conversion rates
  • Performing thorough brand audits of clients' websites to identify areas for improvement
  • Conducting in-depth analysis of user behavior using analytical CRO tools, user feedback, heatmaps, and session recordings to identify trends and opportunities for optimization
  • Designing, executing, and managing A/B and multivariate tests to validate hypotheses and measure the impact of the CRO changes implemented
  • Optimizing brands' landing and product pages, checkout flows, and overall website architecture
  • Collaborating closely with copywriters, designers, and developers to implement best practices and innovative solutions that enhance the user experience and reduce funnel friction points
  • Monitoring and reporting on the performance of CRO initiatives, providing actionable insights and strategic recommendations for continuous improvement
  • Translating complex data and test results into clear, actionable insights and recommendations for clients to ensure that they can make informed decisions
  • Staying up-to-date with the latest trends and tools in the CRO, e-commerce, and digital marketing industries to continuously refine your own strategies and practices
  • Maintaining thorough documentation of all CRO projects, including test results and client interactions, to track progress and outcomes
  • Assisting in the development of CRO case studies and success stories for marketing purposes

Overall, the Conversion Rate Optimization Expert will play an important role in driving measurable growth for our clients by leveraging data-driven insights to optimize their online presence, enhance user experiences, and ultimately increase conversion rates across their e-commerce platforms.

Position specifications:

The Conversion Rate Optimization Expert position includes committing to the following:

  • Full-time commitment while overlapping with our standard office hours (10:00 AM to 6:00 PM UK time)
  • Consistently maintaining an average workload of 40 hours per week
  • Fixed-rate monthly salary paid in USD
  • A 30-day notice period of one calendar month
Requirements

About You:

Profile:

As our Conversion Rate Optimization Expert, you need to bring a highly proactive and analytical approach to your work. You should be able to work independently with high levels of reliability, transparency, and trust. You also need the ability to work under pressure and manage multiple clients' CRO strategies with great attention to detail and the required technical abilities. The ideal person for this role is a rational thinker who enjoys problem-solving, who can work fast and efficiently, and who has excellent communication skills. In addition, good organizational, time management, and analytical skills will help you succeed in this position and work well within our team environment.

Availability and consistency are highly important factors for us, so our Conversion Rate Optimization Expert should display these qualities regarding workload commitments and availability during office hours.

Key traits for this position:

You should demonstrate great attention to detail, strong communication skills, as well as excellent analytical, technical, and problem-solving abilities. A sense of proactivity, hunger for growth, and a consistent, highly communicative work ethic will work in your favor. You will also need a forward-thinking approach to anticipate shifts in user feedback and industry trends, and you should be highly adaptable and open to continuous learning to help you stay ahead in the rapidly evolving e-commerce landscape.

Responsiveness and autonomy will be essential traits for this role.

Key requirements:

The Conversion Rate Optimization Expert position has the following key requirements:

  • A minimum of 3 years of experience in the CRO field
  • Proven experience in a similar CRO role, specifically within the e-commerce industry
  • A proven track record of improving conversion rates for e-commerce clients
  • Proficiency in analytical tools such as Google Analytics, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, and as well as excellent data analysis skills to provide actionable insights to our clients
  • A strong understanding of UX/UI principles and how they affect conversion rates
  • A demonstrated ability to run A/B and multivariate tests from start to finish
  • Experience with e-commerce platforms (such as Shopify, Magento, WooCommerce) and the specific challenges involved in optimizing the user's experience
  • Being familiar with heatmaps, session recordings, and user feedback tools
  • Strong communication skills for effectively presenting test results and recommendations to the team and the clients (direct client communication will not be a requirement of the role, at least not as originally intended)
  • A proactive attitude with a strong focus on delivering high-quality results
  • Being able to work independently and as part of a cross-functional team
  • Being able to handle multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously
  • An excellent attention to detail and a commitment to producing high-quality work
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to finding solutions
  • Familiarity with working autonomously and managing your own time independently and effectively
  • Must have a stable internet connection and a laptop or PC
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English (You must be fluent in English, although English doesn't have to be your native language)
  • Being open to receiving feedback and constructive criticism and improving on it
  • Must be available and responsive during our office hours (10:00 AM to 6:00 PM UK time)
  • Must be able to consistently work full-time

title: Retention Marketing Specialist
description:
To ensure a fair and efficient hiring process, candidates should not contact UN/COMMON employees directly regarding this role. Applications and communication must occur through the official application process.
UN/COMMON is a digital experience and marketing agency that launches and grows the world's best emerging brands. We believe the future of consumer-facing brands starts with creating authentic stories built for the consumer first and brand second. We are extremely proud to work with revolutionary brands such as Selena Gomez's Rare Beauty, Dermalogica, Liquid Death, Lemon Perfect, and more.

We are an employee and customer-centric agency bringing mission first brand stories to life to benefit the greater good and better people's lives. And we have a TON of fun doing it

The Retention Marketing Specialist owns the day-to-day execution of email and SMS production for our clients. This includes project management, content planning, copy and creative briefs, HTML builds, QA, and scheduling. You will manage end-to-end production and keep timelines on track across design, strategy, and client teams. You will work closely with a Retention Marketing Strategist to support retention strategy, reporting, and ongoing optimization. If you enjoy organized workflows, sharp deadlines, clean builds, and improving the customer journey through thoughtful messaging, you will do well here.

What You Will Do

You will manage the full production process for email campaigns and automated flows, build emails in Klaviyo or similar ESPs, write on-brand copy, create clear briefs for the design team, QA content and logic, and schedule deployments. You will maintain the monthly content calendar, drive timelines with clients, and ensure all assets and approvals stay on track. You will support the Retention Marketing Strategist by pulling performance data, analyzing results, and developing recommendations. You will build automated workflows, segmentation, and list logic, maintain list hygiene, and work confidently with Shopify apps such as Yotpo, Loyalty Lion, JustUno, and Privy.

Based on our projected customer base growth, we foresee the need for a  Retention Marketing Specialist  within the next 2-4 months to ensure we can effectively manage and nurture our expanding user community.

Requirements

What You Need

  • 2 years of experience in retention marketing, specifically across email, SMS, CRM, or loyalty programs.
  • Hands-on experience with an Email Service Platform (ESP), with a strong preference for Klaviyo.
  • Strong copywriting skills for direct-to-consumer (DTC) e-commerce, with the ability to adapt tone and style to match different client brands.
  • A solid understanding of email analytics and the ability to translate data insights into actionable strategy.
  • Clear understanding of the difference between marketing campaigns and automated flows, and knowing when to deploy each.
  • Proficiency in building segmented customer lists using behavioral and transactional data.
  • Experience working within Shopify or directly supporting Shopify-based clients.
  • A proactive, organized approach, with the ability to think through the entire customer journey and work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative team.

What Success Looks Like

Your production process is smooth, predictable, and organized. Clients trust your communication and follow your timelines. Email and SMS performance improves because of your quality and attention to detail. Strategy and reporting move faster because you stay ahead of data and execution. You keep projects aligned, informed, and on schedule. You take ownership, ask smart questions, and keep work moving forward.

Benefits

This is a contract position
Up to 40 hours weekly
Remote
Selection Process

The selection process includes a video interview screening, followed by role-specific discussions (possible assessment) and a final leadership conversation.

Commitment to Inclusion

UN/COMMON is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all employees can thrive and bring their full selves to work.

About UN/COMMON

UN/COMMON has been recognized by Inc. Magazine as one of the fastest-growing private companies in America, reflecting our people-driven approach to growth, innovation, and excellence.

Agency Policy

Recruiting agencies are not authorized to submit candidates for this role. UN/COMMON does not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate submissions from agencies.

title: Fund Accountant, Implementations
description:
The Company You'll Join


Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta's platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta's Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don't work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta's software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it's a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital. 

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You'll Solve


As an Implementations Accountant, you will focus efforts on supporting new Fund Administration customers in their journey into Carta services.  You will drive operational excellence within our fast-growing Fund Administration business by coordinating, facilitating and managing onboarding activities that are critical to achieving success for both our customers and Carta within a tight deadline.

In this role you will be responsible for interacting with a fund's back office (CFO, fund manager) to collect their historical data, provide advisory support, and ultimately deliver accurate financial statements to both the client and internal stakeholders. 

From sale close, to implementation, and continued customer success, the ideal Implementations Accountant will exhibit a high degree of problem-solving, efficiency, and integrity as they leverage their subject-matter expertise to provide customers with a world-class onboarding experience. 

The Impact You'll Have

  • Collaborate with new fund clients to collect data and advise on best accounting practices within Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
  • Effectively liaise between sales and Fund Accounting teams as the bridge post-sales
  • Identify process and quality improvements and highlight them to appropriate leadership
  • Create balanced, accurate quarterly financial statements from, at times, unstructured client data
  • Project manage and delegate to internal teams and collaborators located across the globe.

About You

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field, or equivalent experience
  • 1+ years of experience in a role with a finance or accounting background
  • Strong accounting analysis with the ability to interpret a story through unstructured data
  • Committed to team and project success, emotionally intelligent in navigating relationships, transparent and forthright when communicating information, and passionate about growing and advancing with Carta
  • Proven internal influencer having implemented and successfully managed both small and large projects or initiatives with sustained, measurable success
  • Incredible organizational skills, high attention to detail, and an ability to complete competing priorities quickly and autonomously
  • Ability to communicate in both written and verbal formats in a timely and appropriate manner
  • Fluent in English, both written and verbal

Nice-to-Haves

  • Acumen in or knowledge of accounting with a specific focus in venture, hedge fund, and/or private equity
  • Familiarity as an end user with Carta or other financial dataset or accounting software programs

title: Enterprise Architect
description:
Enterprise Architect. Rio de Janeiro. Posting Date: 02/17/2026. Deadline: 03/16/2026

Role Title: Enterprise Architect

Contract Type: Regular

Reporting To: Deputy CIO

Program/Department/Unit Name: Information Technology

Location: Rio & Mexico City

Team Name: IT Governance

Role Purpose

The Enterprise Architect role is responsible for designing and managing the overall architecture of an organization's IT systems and infrastructure. This role involves aligning IT strategy with business goals, creating architectural frameworks, and ensuring that technology solutions are scalable, secure, and efficient. The Enterprise Architect collaborates with various internal and external stakeholders to identify technology needs and guide the implementation of IT initiatives.

Key responsibilities

As the Enterprise Architect, your key responsibilities are as follows:

  • Establish EA governance, EA frameworks, EA methodology and create EA artifacts, EA standards and best practices.
  • Design and promote architectural standards, guidelines, and best practices across the organization.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to identify business requirements and translate them into architectural solutions.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends to inform architectural decisions and recommendation
  • Facilitate architecture review boards and governance processes to ensure compliance with architectural standards.
  • Provide guidance and support to project teams in implementing architectural solutions.
  • Instruct, manage, and mentor development teams
  • Communicate enterprise architecture with other department managers within the organization, outsourcing providers and report on continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Oversee Change Control board, participate in Project Review Board to ensure adherence to architectural standards.     

People Responsibilities (Total Team/DRs)

No

Key metrics

EA KPIs such as strategic alignment, business process optimization, innovation enablement, efficiency, architecture compliance and risk management

Key internal relationships

CIO, Deputy CIO, Functional leads, Operations leads, GDPR team, Legal, Finance, Global Security, IT Security, Technology Services, System/Application Owners, Program/Opportunity leads.

Key external relationships

IT vendors in various markets, external consulting experts, EA colleagues at non-profit institutions with similar IT landscape, large global software providers, etc. 

The ideal candidate

Essential

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or a related field
  • Master's degree in IT management, business management, or enterprise architecture
  • Certifications such TOGAF, CISSP (for cybersecurity focus), and cloud-specific certifications from providers like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud are beneficial
  • 10 years of relevant experience in Enterprise Architecture, with a background in software engineering, network security, cloud computing, systems analysis, data management or other related fields.
  • Strong understanding of business needs, technology trends, and architectural frameworks.
  • Experience creating and maintaining comprehensive Enterprise Architecture frameworks.
  • Experience with architecture modelling tools CAD, BIM, and 3D modelling software.
  • Strong understanding of IT enterprise systems and platforms (Salesforce, NetSuite, Workday) and architectures
  • Deep knowledge of various technologies, including cloud computing, data management, networking, and security.
  • Ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to analyse complex business problems and develop innovative solutions.
  • Ability to lead and mentor development teams and influence stakeholders.
  • Experience with architectural frameworks and methodologies TOGAF or Zachman, and agile methodologies.
  • Experience with cloud computing, network security, data management, and application integration.
  • High level understanding and interest of geo-political implications of Open Society's work.
  • Travel is required. Travel frequency depends on the role requirements.

Languages

  • An excellent knowledge of English

What we offer  

  • Exceptional opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact; from a generous annual professional development allowance for every employee to onsite training and learning conversations with visiting experts.
  • Excellent benefits and perks to promote well-being and a healthy work-life balance, including:
    • Generous time off and flexible work arrangements.
    • Employer-paid health insurance and dental plans for individuals and families (no employee contribution required).
    • Exceptional retirement savings plan (non-contributory for employees) and life insurance.
    • Progressive paid parental leave, reproductive and family planning support, and much more.
  • A commitment to nurturing a diverse and inclusive workplace, so you can bring your whole self to work and make a positive impact.

The salary range for this role in the US is $ 145,666 - $ 161,851 (USD). The final offer is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set and level of experience

Who we are       

Open Society Foundations aim to establish vibrant and inclusive democracies where governments are accountable to their citizens. Our operating model organizes grantmaking around specific, time-limited projects, developed alongside support for established partners, enabling us to respond swiftly to emerging needs. We are committed to promoting human dignity, equality, and rights; reimagining democratic ideals and practice; and advancing equity in governance systems.

Guided by our founder's values and the belief in the art of the possible, we engage directly with global entities, individuals, and policymakers through grants, advocacy, impact investing, and strategic human rights litigation to drive positive change. At the heart of our mission is a deep commitment to rights, equity, and justice, inspiring every action we take.

Additional information

Open Society Foundations is committed to building an inclusive workforce that reflects the communities we serve. We actively seek applications from talented individuals across all backgrounds, identities, and life experiences. Each candidate is evaluated solely on their unique qualifications without regard to race, age, sex, religion, ethnic origin, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, or any other legally protected characteristics.
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities.

Competitive rates of pay apply.

Open Society Foundations is committed to advancing diversity, equity and inclusion, and to building a diverse staff that reflects the movements, issues and communities that our mission serves. Candidates from all underrepresented backgrounds, identities and communities are encouraged to apply.   

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants and colleagues with disabilities.

title: Analista de Comunicação Externa Sênior
description:
Já se imaginou fazendo parte da maior empresa de beleza do mundo?
A L'Oréal está presente em mais de 150 países em cinco continentes. Por mais de um século, a L'Oréal dedicou-se exclusivamente a "criar a beleza que move o mundo"; é agora a líder mundial da indústria, com vendas consolidadas de €29 bilhões. Juntos, resolvemos desafios complexos em grande escala, enquanto continuamos comprometidos em tornar o mundo um lugar mais inclusivo e melhor para todos e para o nosso planeta. Experimente a emoção da agilidade para moldar o futuro da beleza; onde diversidade e propósito se unem e criam um impacto significativo.
Na L'Oréal Grande Público, nossa missão é democratizar o melhor da beleza, que significa levar a beleza para todos. E para nós, a beleza deve ser sustentável. A Divisão de Grande Público porta a marca número 1 de beleza no mundo com L'Oréal Paris, a marca número 1 de maquiagem com Maybelline New York, a marca natural número 1 com Garnier. A DPGP é a maior divisão do grupo L'Oréal, com mais de 30mil colaboradores ao redor do mundo.
Missão
Buscamos um profissional sênior com visão sistêmica para liderar a integração entre comunicação de marca e transformação social. O desafio central desta posição é construir uma agenda "Always On" de impacto social e sustentabilidade, com foco em comunicação, para as marcas da L'Oréal Grande Público (L'Oréal Paris, Garnier, Maybelline NY, Niely e Colorama).
Este profissional vai liderar a estratégia que conecta os stakeholders internos e externos (ONGs, empresas parceiras, imprensa etc.) em torno de um propósito contínuo. O objetivo é garantir que o compromisso social da divisão e de marcas como L'Oréal Paris (programa Stand Up) sejam um pilar perene de reputação e valor de marca, alavancando a reputação e o impacto das marcas com diferentes comunidades.
Principais Atividades
Criar e gerir um calendário anual de impacto social que garanta visibilidade constante às causas da divisão, evitando hiatos de comunicação e mantendo o tema vivo para todos os stakeholders.
Liderar a gestão do programa StandUp em parceria com o Marketing Institucional e a ONG parceira, garantindo que a causa do combate ao assédio sexual seja um tema onipresente na narrativa de L'Oréal Paris.
Idealizar e operar iniciativas de sustentabilidade e impacto social dentro das ações de marca, assegurando que cada lançamento de produto ou evento tenha uma camada de propósito que reforce a reputação da divisão.
Atuar como o embaixador da divisão frente ao terceiro setor, estabelecendo parcerias de longo prazo que vão além do apoio financeiro, focando em cocriação e troca de expertises.
Mobilizar e engajar os times internos (stakeholders internos) para que a agenda social seja parte da cultura do negócio, transformando colaboradores em embaixadores das causas da divisão.
Manter relacionamento estratégico com jornalistas, influenciadores e formadores de opinião para garantir que as ações de impacto social tenham eco e relevância na opinião pública.
Apoiar o time de Comunicação e PR em ações de comunicação de marca, incluindo lançamentos e campanhas.
Traduzir dados e ações sociais em narrativas envolventes para imprensa e canais digitais, garantindo consistência e qualidade em todas as frentes de comunicação.
Analisar a performance das campanhas de comunicação e o progresso das metas sociais, sendo responsável pelos reportes de impacto.
Requisitos e Qualificações
Sólida experiência em Comunicação Corporativa, Brand PR ou áreas de Responsabilidade Social. Experiência prévia em comunicação e projetos de impacto social, é um diferencial.
Capacidade de influenciar pares e lideranças internas para priorizar a agenda social no dia a dia da operação.
Entendimento de como o impacto social se traduz em valor de marca (brandequity) e lealdade do consumidor.
Perfil proativo para tirar grandes ideias do papel e gerenciar a operação detalhada de parcerias com ONGs e eventos.
O Que Você Vai Encontrar
Possibilidade de crescimento, incluindo carreira internacional;
Ambiente inclusivo e diverso;
Cultura voltada para pessoas, pessoas e pessoas
Estamos empenhados em garantir processos de recrutamento inclusivos e em defender a contratação e promoção de cada candidato de forma ética e equitativa.
O Grupo proíbe estritamente a discriminação contra qualquer candidato a emprego devido à identidade ou expressão de gênero do indivíduo, orientação sexual, deficiência visível e/ou invisível, origem socioeconômica e/ou multicultural, condições de saúde, idade, religião ou quaisquer outras características protegidas por lei. title: Human Factors Engineer- Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat Relocation Package.
Job Overview
We are seeking a Human Factors Engineer to join the Loss Prevention Organization (LP).
LP is responsible for providing both day-to-day in-field occupational and process safety support to Saudi Aramco operations, as well as centralized technical support and consulting function. Our field offices are located in Abqaiq, Riyadh, Ras Tanura, Dhahran, Udhailiyah, Jeddah (including Yanbu and Jazan), and Tanajib. Through these offices, LP provides its services to all Saudi Aramco facilities and departments that are located throughout the Kingdom.
Your primary role is to embed principles of human and organizational factors in operational process and capital projects, promote a sound safety culture, build human factors capability in the company and share human factors knowledge as well as engage with the industry.
Key Responsibilities
As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:
Develop corporate policies, guidelines, standards and specifications for human factors.
Develop tools to incorporate human factors in qualitative and quantitative risk assessments (e.g., human failure analysis, safety critical task analysis, human reliability analysis) as well as support risk assessment activities that involve these tools.
Introduce human performance tools to error-proof routine and non-routine field activities, including embedding human factors thinking into the day-to-day activities (e.g., site inspections, work permitting, pre and post job briefings, JSA).
Participate, review and analyze human factors issues in incident investigations.
Advise on Human Factors Engineering (HFE) integration in capital projects, verifying compliance with international and company HFE standards as well as Human-Machine Interface (HMI) specifications.
Streamline critical communications for frontline workers, advising on shift turnover practices, communication interfaces between work group and between organizations.
Advise facilities on how to manage fatigue risk and best practices in shift work schedule design, including safe manning levels, optimal workload and allocation of functions.
Develop programs and strategies for driving and sustaining a positive safety culture, operationalizing proven methods to assess safety culture, and driving targeted interventions.
Develop methods to measure psychological safety and action plans to address areas for improvement.
Identify and lead the deployment of innovative technologies to reduce human failure.
Provide awareness as well as technical training for different human factors topics.
Mentor other LP personnel.
Minimum Requirements
You will hold a Bachelor degree in Engineering, industrial psychology, human factors, ergonomics, or safety from an Accredited Institution
You will have 7 years of experience as a human factor professional in the oil and gas, petrochemicals, or related industries, including as strong track record in delivering results.
You will hold a recognized certification in human factors such as Certified Human Factors Professional (CHFP), Certified Professional Ergonomist (CPE), Chartered Ergonomics and Human Factors Specialist (C.ErgHF), or European Ergonomist (Eur.Erg).
You will have an excellent ability to communicate in English with peers as well as members of management, and be able to produce clear and concise oral and written reports in English.
Working Environment
Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.
At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world's biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.
We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.
Aramco energizes the world economy.
Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world's largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.
With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco's value to society.
Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations' spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom's vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.
We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

Todos os nossos cargos estão abertos a pessoas com deficiência.

title: Postbaccalaureate Research Fellow-1
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff "for fit" makes significant contributions to Howard University's overall mission.
At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.
Here Is What We Offer
Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture
Join Howard University and thrive with us
Basic Function
Full-time laboratory research position in Alzheimer's disease and related dementia (ADRD). Key responsibilities include:
Conduct experiments utilizing various techniques specific to the laboratory to investigate mechanisms and treatment strategies of ADRD. Maintain detailed and accurate records of experimental procedures and results.
Collect, maintain, analyze, and interpret experimental data using appropriate statistical and analytical methods. Contribute to the preparation of research presentations and manuscripts. Participate in lab meeting seminars, and collaborative research discussions. Assist with general lab maintenance and organization, including ordering supplies and ensuring compliance with safety regulations.
Supervisory Authority
Host laboratory mentors and program leadership provide supervisory authority for HU-ERA-PREP Scholars. Fellows will report to assigned research mentors at host labs, who will provide direct oversight, mentorship and project management including ensuring accurate documentation and presentation of research activities and findings. Research supervisors will enforce compliance with institutional policies ethical guidelines and safety regulations. Regular performance evaluations will be conducted to provide constructive feedback, identify areas for improvement as well as recognize exceptional performance and contributions.
Nature And Scope
Fellows will engage in advanced research focused on mechanisms underlying Alzheimer's disease or related dementias including preventative and treatment strategies. This position offers a unique opportunity for recent graduates to gain hands-on research experience and contribute to high-impact projects in a collaborative and supportive environment.
Principal Accountabilities
Postbaccalaureate Research Fellows in Alzheimer's disease research, will play a critical role in advancing understanding of the mechanisms underlying this complex neurological disorder. In addition to basic research functions, fellows are expected to:
Work collaboratively with principal investigators, postdoctoral fellows and other research staff including assisting in mentoring and training junior lab members.
Engage in continuous learning by staying current with relevant advances in the field. Attend workshops, seminars, and conferences to enhance skills and knowledge.
Seek feedback and opportunities for growth in research practices and methodologies.
Core Competencies
Previous research experience is preferred but not required.
Data analysis capabilities, proficiency in using analytical software.
Attention to detail and meticulous record-keeping.
Willingness to learn new techniques and adapt to evolving research needs.
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Ability to work collaboratively with diverse individuals and foster a cooperative lab environment.
Commitment to ethical research practices and adherence to institutional and regulatory guidelines
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in a related field (e.g., biology, neuroscience, psychology, biomedical sciences, biomedical engineering). Received a Bachelor's degree within the past two years. Strong academic record with a 3.2 minimum GPA. Desire to pursue a research-focused career in Alzheimer's disease and related dementias. Prior biomedical research experience preferred but not required

Working from Retic office in Rio de Janeiro/RJ

We are an energy technology company that provides solutions to energy and industrial customers worldwide. é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos , de 04/03/1966, de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,
Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS)
e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Responsabilidades e atribuições
Realizar anamnese e avaliações pedagógicas pertinentes ao desenvolvimento cognitivo e à aprendizagem.

Identificar o nível atual de desenvolvimento, habilidades acadêmicas, cognitivas e de vida diária.

Criar, em conjunto com a equipe, metas específicas para o desenvolvimento pedagógico do assistido, respeitando seu ritmo e interesses (Plano de Ensino Individualizado).

Escolher e adaptar estratégias baseadas em evidências (como ABA, TEACCH ou PECS) para facilitar o aprendizado.

Realizar visitas periódicas às escolas onde os assistidos estão matriculados para orientar professores e mediadores.

Auxiliar a escola na adaptação de provas, materiais e atividades pedagógicas.

Instruir a equipe escolar sobre como lidar com crises ou comportamentos desafiadores de forma pedagógica e inclusiva.

Redigir relatórios de evolução, pareceres pedagógicos e registros de frequência detalhados para acompanhamento clínico.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Superior Completo em Pedagogia;
  • Pós-graduação em Educação Especial, Educação Inclusiva ou Desenvolvimento Infantil;
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe;
  • Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função.

Horário de Trabalho: 20h semanais

title: Field Service Engineer, Shaft Line Solutions
description:
Wärtsilä is a world leader in marine technology and leading the industry's transformation towards a decarbonised and sustainable future. With the world's widest portfolio and service network, we – Wärtsilians - deliver efficient, safe and sustainable integrated products and solutions to enhance the business of our customers. The opportunities presented through digitalisation and new technologies are offering a new era of shipping. Did you know that shipping is the world's most efficient mode of transportation and that 88% of the world's trade is carried by sea?
We want to change the course towards an interconnected and cleaner maritime future and are constantly on the lookout for future-oriented talent to join our team and to work towards enabling sustainable societies through innovation in technology and services - together. Are you ready to jump onboard?
We are now looking for a Field Service Engineer, Shaft Line Solutions (SLS) to join our team working for a better future.
This is a permanent position, and candidates may be based anywhere in Chile, Panama, Brazil, or Colombia. The role requires travel of up to 80% of the time (domestically and internationally).
What You Will Be Doing
As a Field Service Engineer, SLS, you will play a key role in ensuring the reliable performance of Wärtsilä shaft line systems by delivering high-quality field service, technical expertise, and customer support.
As a Field Service Engineer, Shaft Line Solutions, you will focus on these responsibilities:
Perform Field Service activities according to the work scope.
Perform overhauls and repairs on assemblies on site and/or in workshops.
Interact professionally with customers during the work execution.
Provide internal and external progress status updates.
Create Service Work Reports
Ensure that the work is executed according to Wärtsilä QEHS guidelines and site procedures.
Continuously seek solutions in accordance to best practises.
To be successful in this role, we expect you to have:
Required qualifications:
Minimum 5+ years of experience in the mechanical engineering industry, preferably within the marine sector.
Completed apprenticeship or Associate/bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or related field.
Fluency in English (written and verbal).
Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite.
Ability and willingness to travel up to 80%, domestically and internationally; must hold or be able to obtain a valid passport.
Ability and willingness to work on‑call, providing support during evenings, weekends, or holidays as operational needs arise.
Valid driver's license.
Demonstrated experience in installation, operation, maintenance, and repair of mechanical systems.
Excellent customer communication skills with the ability to clearly convey technical information, interact professionally, and deliver effective solutions during service execution.
Strong commitment to a safety-first mindset.
Desired qualifications:
Ideally 2+ years of hands-on experience with shaft seals or marine propulsion systems.
Knowledge of propulsion shaft alignment and vibration analysis is highly beneficial.
Experience working with electrical systems, hydraulics, or automation systems is an asset.
Spanish verbal skills are considered an advantage.

· Recepcionar os clientes de forma cordial e eficiente, anotando os pedidos de maneira clara e ágil.

· Manter a área de atendimento e de trabalho organizadas e pronta para receber novos clientes.

Garantir a limpeza e a organização do ambiente de trabalho:

· Manter a estação de preparo limpa e organizada, seguindo as normas de higiene e segurança alimentar.

title: Freelance IT Project Manager/Digital and Web Projects
description:
pubGENIUS is a and development agency and ad tech startup. We build web and application products for clients in the US and Europe. Core industries include DeFi, crypto, blockchain, fintech, healthcare, and e-commerce.

Role We are hiring an IT or Digital Project Manager to run multiple international client projects end to end. You will work closely with engineers, designers, and global clients to deliver high-quality digital products on time and within scope. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys ownership, clear communication, and fast-moving agency environments.

  • Provide regular status updates to clients
  • Validate delivered features against client requirements
  • Track delivery performance and project KPIs with the PM Lead

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Project Management, Business Administration or related fields;
  • At least 4 years of proven experience in IT project management or digital product development in the agency environment;
  • Strong experience in software project sales process - preparing project proposal, budgeting techniques, discovery phase management etc.
  • Good working knowledge of project estimation techniques;
  • Strong business acumen in project planning and management;
  • Good knowledge of Agile methodologies;
  • Ability to lead project teams of various sizes and see them through to completion;
  • Good Knowledge of project management tools;
  • Fluent in English is a must; ( Strong B2 , C1)

Skills

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills to coordinate with team members;
  • Good project management and leadership skills;
  • A highly organized approach with prioritization skills;
  • Good analytical skills and problem-solving skills to handle any situation and issues that occur during project completion;
  • Organization and time management skills to keep projects on track and within budget;
  • Understanding of different cultures to work with international team members;
  • The ability to work in a fast-paced project environment and under tight deadlines.

Nice to have

  • Experience in print on demand or physical printing businesses
  • Understanding of how print on demand operations work
  • E-commerce project experience

Benefits

  • Work from anywhere;
  • Working hours Flexibility;
  • Vacation and sick days;

description:
O Analista Financeiro Imobiliário Júnior é responsável por fornecer suporte financeiro e analítico específico para o setor imobiliário da empresa. Este profissional auxilia na análise de viabilidade de projetos imobiliários, controle de orçamentos, e acompanhamento financeiro de empreendimentos, colaborando para a gestão eficiente dos investimentos e operações imobiliárias. Principais Responsabilidades:Auxiliar na avaliação financeira de novos projetos imobiliários, incluindo análises de retorno sobre investimento (ROI), custo de capital e projeções de fluxo de caixa. title: Artífice - RJ
description:
O Artífice é um profissional multifuncional responsável por realizar serviços de manutenção, reparos e pequenas obras em diversas áreas, como alvenaria, carpintaria, pintura, hidráulica. Esse cargo requer habilidade para executar diferentes tipos de trabalhos manuais, garantindo a conservação e o bom funcionamento das instalações e equipamentos. Principais Responsabilidades:Realizar a manutenção preventiva e corretiva em instalações e equipamentos, abrangendo áreas como, hidráulica, alvenaria, pintura, e carpintaria e afins. Efetuar pequenos reparos em estruturas físicas, como paredes, pisos, portas, janelas, redes hidráulicas. Executar instalações e montagens de itens diversos, como móveis, prateleiras, divisórias, luminárias, e outros equipamentos necessários.
